| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Hi Friend,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.
---

---
After my time in the service, I felt compelled to continue fighting for what's right and standing up for causes bigger than myself, and I've since been blessed to serve my community as a Congressman and now Governor of Florida. During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited.
---

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Stop the U.S. from funding a polluting gas project in Papua New Guinea![_Act now!_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2009149?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ** The South Pacific Island nation of Papua New Guinea is home to stunning coasts and awe-inspiring coral reefs. These are habitats teeming with life: **scuttling lobsters, soaring stingrays, and clownfish like our friend Nemo.** **But marine heat waves driven by fossil fuels are killing these precious ecosystems. ** Climate change is hitting Papua New Guinea hard. Sea levels are rising faster than the global average, threatening its low-lying islands. **40%** of Papua New Guinea’s population lives below the poverty line, and many communities have already had to **move their homes several times due to rising sea levels. ** The U.S. Export-Import Bank is planning to support a liquefied natural gas project in Papua New Guinea that will create **TOXIC POLLUTION** and **ACCELERATE THE WARMING** that’s killing marine animals and hurting communities. [_**Please, Friend, tell the U.S. Export-Import Bank to reject this CLIMATE BOMB gas project in Papua New Guinea before it moves forward. Time is running out! >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2009150?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2009151?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
According to UN researchers, we need to **immediately end all liquefied natural gas investments** to avoid catastrophic global warming. That means not supporting projects like this one in Papua New Guinea. The U.S. previously pledged not to support new projects like this – but it’s poised to violate its own commitment.
This gas project might line the pockets of fossil fuel executives, but it will be a tragedy for the people of Papua New Guinea, marine wildlife, and the entire planet. The question is: **which side should the U.S. be on?** Supporting **fossil fuel companies and planetary destruction,** or standing with **communities and the Earth?** Help ensure the right choice is made. [_**Sign the petition and help STOP the U.S. from funding a catastrophic natural gas development in Papua New Guinea. We need 3,290 more signatures by midnight to hit our goal!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2009152?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Kate DeAngelis

Here's a little bit more about myself, friend. I'm reaching out today to ask if you'll join me.

---

---
Hi Friend,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.
---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7c6c2dbc2dde4e3094a5dd34696a2230&_e=FpVrwOCdi37dDOt6SR23dcEfV2gTDSzWHC7hVg1tl5AshZfWUdnnOleqb2-OZe077mPCheo93LQJtYT1KH9oJchdHhkF7rpkjmqYOsPJZqq7VUto86OzhxH0MKBl-MtaZHusGuL42_zq9wKGwligbAhwuL1_1U2F6llVgDduflIImZXd4cMkFBSJqKUEcaiMEeAHel4_bLDVQCduBhstZVeHRhd8Ek8QN6Hx2Y4eWQCxzEknT2JkFbbmgJyWbuF-3Ce6FFqYeRX9VXbLSkGFA7aNQHzvZ25u3vRz184CxaVi0NzNU-0yu_tQ4ajkJaIeUebNk714j6auxKO8YpqIodp8UZpt1AIXHVu2yX_I35U0xJcR0FhNyJIoVZLsvaMG-1vVftO8-QIj3FtZp8XbJowijd-kDJls5wCIDcrCx_A%3D)
---
After my time in the service, I felt compelled to continue fighting for what's right and standing up for causes bigger than myself, and I've since been blessed to serve my community as a Congressman and now Governor of Florida. During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited.
---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7c6c2dbc2dde4e3094a5dd34696a2230&_e=FpVrwOCdi37dDOt6SR23dcEfV2gTDSzWHC7hVg1tl5AshZfWUdnnOleqb2-OZe077mPCheo93LQJtYT1KH9oJchdHhkF7rpkjmqYOsPJZqq7VUto86OzhxH0MKBl-MtaZHusGuL42_zq9wKGwligbAhwuL1_1U2F6llVgDduflIImZXd4cMkFBSJqKUEcaiMEeAHel4_bLDVQCduBhstZVeHRhd8Ek8QN6Hx2Y4eWQCxzEknT2JkFbbmgJyWbuF-3Ce6FFqYeRX9VXbLSkGFA7NCQwHWpxIeMxOp_k9TdEwIhdag2Vkj5HdNFm45wnflDOj3DB6pF-81kJNSBf6pj7LbVp0qrPqCVRRcjG-wfdhvocjeRz_LwsHF3Xjht832s3TdT56LnNq9pG2KtwVW2dCpulNFq0JQae0Elr-DpOo%3D)

But, Friend, we do not have to accept this decline. It CAN be reversed, and I believe we have a responsibility to step up and do it. This cannot wait another four years. If you share this belief in a better tomorrow with me, I am humbly asking you to join my team. You should know that every dollar counts in this race, and every contribution to my team goes so much farther than you could know. That's why, if you join my team by making any donation of just $5 or more, I want to welcome you with a free bumper sticker.

While we put your contribution to good use out on the trail--reaching new voters, hosting big events, producing all kinds of merchandise, advertising across the country, building our network, raising the resources we need to keep going--you could be making an even bigger impact by spreading the word right where you are. I have made it my mission to always lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. With your help, we won't lose. We will reverse the decline of this country and get the job done. You'll see very quickly I'm not like anyone else in this race. In the state of Florida, everything I promised we would do, we've gotten done, and then some, when's the last time anybody you've elected has over-delivered on their promises? As your next President, I promise I'll do the same thing. It's time for the Republican party to buck this culture of losing. You can count on me, Friend. I hope I can count on you.

In Freedom

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Hi Friend,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.

During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited.

Hi Friend,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.
---
| [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=02b449b6abf840c8a07d1e61ed7d0c73&_e=hKES4h6bcLNgG1y9gPdUCrniQWEy0ndjpnsZYRQmbD2JW8o23saRGob_E41OcCTrwfoXUH2ZTSUIWmAIhEWQG6GI7_h23KGT6re68gUwACYBOhBPkqC1RTS_9LRUlTCU9G-28H5Lu2efoVFeBi_-tIh3iZjfDambFC6r8Jw_stW_sGjaaCVZvAE7XDGcfR4m-Zwz467JFoxFw5lfUXVDiNd_mCaRH8p7od4pAIVQf8RyQQ0WA5tP56GlrOSysi2b9CWYbXLwHMSkZRyu5ioyzwbNm0vYf0VHrakDa87KMr6J1-yUmq9D-_FW6k2SO2Mzh9XMydIuTR00MSW_Uy6WWWFE6eo_MepcxHr2sF6oFmf6VXqYNtzlk-a5S0M6xA7sjyVsmSggirPc4mRHMthxUmwXdqizM1ohJpSQRt5sPDE%3D)
---
After my time in the service, I felt compelled to continue fighting for what's right and standing up for causes bigger than myself, and I've since been blessed to serve my community as a Congressman and now Governor of Florida. During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited.
---

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

---
Hi Friend,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.
---

---

During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited.
---

You should know that every dollar counts in this race, and every contribution to my team goes so much farther than you could know. body:
Here's a little bit more about myself, friend. I'm reaching out today to ask if you'll join me.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=492363cf1e4b4b50b46509c4b0f4f74c&_e=-mgS_J155UbuPSOtciD1iZDLUZI_B8JYEq_QUj1Ir3IO-2eAyNTi9UwtwVuYrAY1v5fMbAdF_gYCyjmjO5PK7Kgq5ghvIYHytd6AtkDY14eeCE527AMWFzdB_AtimJ2-FdHJliXjtC9vn3lajFBqcWdWlMF88qZYNOy5d-Swnsrx7B1lgXtaB0eGNpAPIzDy2lOO2237nTfzY6cu71yn0JHnFlpAeHaGTE_LSHqJR8aK3VuYHQAxppawi8x-6Lq-pNzs9ajzm_hcwxdyQCi5Ru4vRk13ZRVrQJkhUNRuIw32oiTjtCFovEmwQ-th2LCkDoGGbzs82owPUUmWH2cnLsDlBpZnQlWt1WAI571wbYtGg_2ykld_i3GXQPruuurI-kV_jhbRzEYZwdO5pdUV6zz8EwXfqhBokU96cLF9_h4%3D)
---
Hi Friend,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.
---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=492363cf1e4b4b50b46509c4b0f4f74c&_e=-mgS_J155UbuPSOtciD1iZDLUZI_B8JYEq_QUj1Ir3IO-2eAyNTi9UwtwVuYrAY1v5fMbAdF_gYCyjmjO5PK7Kgq5ghvIYHytd6AtkDY14eeCE527AMWFzdB_AtimJ2-FdHJliXjtC9vn3lajFBqcWdWlMF88qZYNOy5d-Swnsrx7B1lgXtaB0eGNpAPIzDy2lOO2237nTfzY6cu71yn0JHnFlpAeHaGTE_LSHqJR8aK3VuYHQAxppawi8x-6Lq-pNzs9ajzm_hcwxdyQCi5Rp22D8CQjgiA0rM3hCDUjLyAeJcSKIk79_Twl9NXnryvRfLsLEXmvc5zABg6_42IFyEgfRmUHr38_D9-w4ygHjzopYRPqJGDULXzvXsAvLaVUNNSLnBrduo9NfgrH2V9Nqdzc0ooNGv8dz7QPL4ebL8%3D)
---
After my time in the service, I felt compelled to continue fighting for what's right and standing up for causes bigger than myself, and I've since been blessed to serve my community as a Congressman and now Governor of Florida. During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited.
---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=492363cf1e4b4b50b46509c4b0f4f74c&_e=-mgS_J155UbuPSOtciD1iZDLUZI_B8JYEq_QUj1Ir3IO-2eAyNTi9UwtwVuYrAY1v5fMbAdF_gYCyjmjO5PK7Kgq5ghvIYHytd6AtkDY14eeCE527AMWFzdB_AtimJ2-FdHJliXjtC9vn3lajFBqcWdWlMF88qZYNOy5d-Swnsrx7B1lgXtaB0eGNpAPIzDy2lOO2237nTfzY6cu71yn0JHnFlpAeHaGTE_LSHqJR8aK3VuYHQAxppawi8x-6Lq-pNzs9ajzm_hcwxdyQCi5RhlBpcRO21OgECLrFDHoO9FCG9YY5PRS33jUeNqs6osuyVPVMyYl0lbzDqFWiC8bwc9FxPGtU3C_sop2ObzLRtGOcVGmqwdvUybwadGPdpwrCeA6cbDLW0JGApgR_WHOdCbYW3Nn1N74wlyj5KQlaqs%3D)
---
But, Friend, we do not have to accept this decline. It CAN be reversed, and I believe we have a responsibility to step up and do it. This cannot wait another four years. If you share this belief in a better tomorrow with me, I am humbly asking you to join my team. You should know that every dollar counts in this race, and every contribution to my team goes so much farther than you could know. That's why, if you join my team by making any donation of just $5 or more, I want to welcome you with a free bumper sticker.
---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=492363cf1e4b4b50b46509c4b0f4f74c&_e=-mgS_J155UbuPSOtciD1iZDLUZI_B8JYEq_QUj1Ir3IO-2eAyNTi9UwtwVuYrAY1v5fMbAdF_gYCyjmjO5PK7Kgq5ghvIYHytd6AtkDY14eeCE527AMWFzdB_AtimJ2-FdHJliXjtC9vn3lajFBqcWdWlMF88qZYNOy5d-Swnsrx7B1lgXtaB0eGNpAPIzDy2lOO2237nTfzY6cu71yn0JHnFlpAeHaGTE_LSHqJR8aK3VuYHQAxppawi8x-6Lq-pNzs9ajzm_hcwxdyQCi5RvFyKcv3hjn8q1Xzrc0ctIf-55S1K5rYWwnuIvSz7Zjt30t2hwXtcDcjyO8IBUcxtNw3EqtC_ubPVttFEA91KVpXSBfmaLxeugFoITfEZdMSdBjGyIW7Nw-3z1_eJ4bT3y3RFetdlfUQoqx2Lnzzgcg%3D)

While we put your contribution to good use out on the trail--reaching new voters, hosting big events, producing all kinds of merchandise, advertising across the country, building our network, raising the resources we need to keep going--you could be making an even bigger impact by spreading the word right where you are. I have made it my mission to always lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. With your help, we won't lose. We will reverse the decline of this country and get the job done. You'll see very quickly I'm not like anyone else in this race. In the state of Florida, everything I promised we would do, we've gotten done, and then some, when's the last time anybody you've elected has over-delivered on their promises? As your next President, I promise I'll do the same thing. It's time for the Republican party to buck this culture of losing. You can count on me, Friend. I hope I can count on you.

In Freedom

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

clean_body: Here's a little bit more about myself, friend. I'm reaching out today to ask if you'll join me. | | | | | | | | | | Hi Friend, I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms. | After my time in the service, I felt compelled to continue fighting for what's right and standing up for causes bigger than myself, and I've since been blessed to serve my community as a Congressman and now Governor of Florida. During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited. | But, Friend, we do not have to accept this decline. It CAN be reversed, and I believe we have a responsibility to step up and do it. This cannot wait another four years. If you share this belief in a better tomorrow with me, I am humbly asking you to join my team. You should know that every dollar counts in this race, and every contribution to my team goes so much farther than you could know. That's why, if you join my team by making any donation of just $5 or more, I want to welcome you with a free bumper sticker. | | | While we put your contribution to good use out on the trail--reaching new voters, hosting big events, producing all kinds of merchandise, advertising across the country, building our network, raising the resources we need to keep going--you could be making an even bigger impact by spreading the word right where you are. I have made it my mission to always lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. With your help, we won't lose. We will reverse the decline of this country and get the job done. You'll see very quickly I'm not like anyone else in this race. In the state of Florida, everything I promised we would do, we've gotten done, and then some, when's the last time anybody you've elected has over-delivered on their promises? As your next President, I promise I'll do the same thing. It's time for the Republican party to buck this culture of losing. You can count on me, Friend. I hope I can count on you. In Freedom | Ron DeSantis | | | Meet Ron DeSantis | | | | | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment. In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular. Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College’s National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjee3db6br867ud671h4oqsjl67moi42brl5dqfo_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdim9ob6c5h2bs)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlepb7o6jh4a30e3ksjrgvklc96etnhtqbd8bsr0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdim9ob6c5h2bs) [NO](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2znuuq86b7pc3n5lfrte31mmbjc91i8itoeb26ugo_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdim9ob6c5h2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to “pack” the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: “To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats.”

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court’s role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zg323ueo8ton5plu0uht83440nf35283octu5qto_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdim9ob6c5h2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I’m sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That’s why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution” and “The U.S. Supreme Court.”

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America’s great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9eafmkeurl1653ghf5570r27lcn1oo7u47cmmno_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdim9ob6c5h2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

Last week, we watched as the House was unable to come to any agreements on funding for the government, as the end of the fiscal year nears (September 30th). Below is a brief summary of what happened and what we expect to happen this week, as well as the call to action. **Summary** There were some members of the House Freedom Caucus who were negotiating with some of the more liberal Republicans to pass a short-term Continuing Resolution (CR) to get something (rather than nothing), particularly border security and some spending cuts. The liberal Republicans were threatening to just pass a “clean” CR with Democrats, which would fund the government at the current levels and do nothing about the border or any other policies we’d like to see implemented. The HFC members who negotiated with the liberal Republicans did this with the best of intentions and in good faith, trying to do what was best for the country. There were other members of the House Freedom Caucus who opposed any Continuing Resolution on principle – knowing that CRs are a huge problem and that we must return to the regular appropriations process where the separate appropriations bills are debated and passed independently. These members were promised in January that the House would finally return to regular order in exchange for their votes for McCarthy as Speaker. Like the HFC members who negotiated with the liberal Republicans, these HFC members took this position with the best of intentions and in good faith, trying to do what was best for the country. The point is, both sides of the House Freedom Caucus were trying to do what was right – and while they differed in strategy, they have the same goal. **What We Expect** Ten of the twelve appropriations bills passed out of the House appropriations committee, and four (and maybe more) are expected to be voted on this week. Those four are Agriculture, Homeland Security, Department of Defense, and S-FOPS (State, Foreign Operations, and related programs). If those four bills pass, we may still wind up with a short-term CR, but we will also have seen significant progress toward passing actual appropriations bills. If they do not pass, we may have a CR deal that we do not like, and it could be very bad. Even as most of the members of the House Republican Conference are attempting to pass individual appropriations bills, some of the “moderates” (a.k.a. liberal republicans because there is nothing moderate about these spending levels) may try to strike a deal with Democrats, using a little-used parliamentary maneuver called a “discharge petition.” Therefore, our call to action this week focuses less on the final vehicle of funding, and more on what we think needs to be in any spending bill or agreement. **Call your Representative and both of your Senators and tell them that any spending bill or bills must include the following!** **SECURE THE BORDER!!** The links below demonstrate the critical situation our nation is in right now because it’s not just an open border – it is an invasion.
* [Biden makes border history with highest illegal crossing attempts ever recorded in a month: 304,162](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-WV3YmsLXnwfkrJbKgA)
* [The total # of illegal border crossings have hit a new RECORD HIGH, already surpassing last year’s.](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjMyNjgtYTVjODE4ODYzYTE5NGQ4MjlkYjU0NGNhMzc3YzQyYmUiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMiIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8veC5jb20vcmVwYmVuY2xpbmUvc3RhdHVzLzE3MDUyNzQ3NDM2MTg3NDg3NjQ_cz00NiZ0PWh3UEdELXNIRVBOQ1VweXVXR3J4MkEmbWlkPTQ2NTI3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/_XaF06Hk__GV4q87J8ygkA)
* [Biden secretly has let 221,456 migrants fly into the US in past year](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)

**Stop the weaponization of government against conservatives!**
* [Merrick Garland disgusts me and should disgust you too](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
* [Tom McClintock Lights Into Merrick Garland Over Hunter Biden Investigation](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjMyNjgtYTVjODE4ODYzYTE5NGQ4MjlkYjU0NGNhMzc3YzQyYmUiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiNSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8veW91dHUuYmUvRWVPTUlxaW1PbWM_ZmVhdHVyZT1zaGFyZWQmbWlkPTQ2NTI3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/WgyJvjKsZ9kiqqQ76T5YQA)

**Stop the wokeness in the military!** This will be harder now that the Senate confirmed C.Q. Brown, a full-on Marxist, as the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
* [Merit in the Armed Forces](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-hJQ5k3InmrLg)
* [How The GOP Establishment Wrecked America In Just One Week](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ2NTI3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/O1z8KaeevltFjuJyYgA1OA)

**Cut spending!** Note that in June the national debt hit $32 trillion, and then last week we hit $33 trillion – they added one trillion dollars to the debt in just three months! **_NOTE: Please watch your email for updated calls to action this week, as things could change very quickly and we might need to urgently change direction._** Thank you! | | | Hey folks -- John Kennedy here.

I respect you too much to beat around the bush. You're busy. I'm busy. So I'll do you the courtesy of cutting to the chase:

My Republican colleagues over there in the People's House have a very, VERY big deadline coming down the pike, and they sent me a note saying they're falling **DANGEROUSLY** behind their big End-of-Quarter goal.

They also made it abundantly clear to me that they'd have a real mess on their hands if they came up short.

_**[So with all due respect, I'm humbly asking you to send in a small contribution before time is officially out. We've only got a few hours left for a last-minute surge before the big deadline, so anything you can spare would be a HUGE help.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z86md9frn02qmakj15akf4l61l4e2rtdemlelj2g_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdhm4pr1cth2bs "So with all due respect, I’m humbly asking you to send in a small contribution before time is officially out. We’ve only got a few hours left for a last-minute surge before the big deadline, so anything you can spare would be a HUGE help. ")**_

_Do you think you could do that? For me?_

| | | **It's Go Time.** **I've been on the campaign trail nonstop since January of 2022. We joke that I took about 3 days off after the November 2022 election and then got back to it, but that's actually pretty accurate. Why didn't I stop campaigning? Because I'm compelled by my mission that the people of this region be accurately represented in US Congress.

There's a pervasive current of feeling throughout much of California that the "votes cast" don't accurately reflect the opinions and wishes of the electorate. Those of us with boots on the ground hear this time and time again. The current "Representative" in office for CA18 isn't necessarily conducting herself in Washington DC with the faces of the hardworking people of Salinas, King City, Watsonville, Morgan Hill, or East San Jose in mind.

I, however, will. We need a complete reversal of direction in Washington DC. From top to bottom in government we see "leaders" mired in misbehavior - bribery, corruption, greed. The people of this nation, we Americans, of this nation are merely an afterthought, or a stepping stone, if that. You, we, deserve the government our founders envisioned, not the disaster it's become.**

**I am Of the People, By the people and For the people. Help send me to Congress! I have a big fundraiser coming up in Hollister and I'd love to see you there.**
**In Liberty,
Peter Hernandez**
