body:
Another incredible week on the campaign trail! I️ had the privilege of meeting numerous Hoosiers and celebrating life at two Right to Life events!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

I hope this newsletter finds you well. It's been an incredible week on the campaign trail, and I'm thrilled to share some highlights with you. Over the past week, I had the privilege of connecting with Hoosiers and celebrating life at two Right to Life events. I'm truly inspired by the support and enthusiasm I've encountered along the way.

Read on for a recap of some of the events from this past week!

Let's keep the conversation going! Follow me on social to keep up with the campaign. Have questions, comments or concerns? Send me an email!
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://twitter.com/Suzanne_Crouch?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D Twitter (https://twitter.com/Suzanne_Crouch?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.instagram.com/crouchforindiana/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/crouchforindiana/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://crouchforindiana.com?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D Website (https://crouchforindiana.com?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
mailto:info@crouchforindiana.com Email (mailto:info@crouchforindiana.com)

** ICYMI: 'Axe The Tax' Featured on Indy Politics
------------------------------------------------------------

Gubernatorial candidate Lt. Governor Suzanne Crouch says she can eliminate Indiana’s individual income.

It’s estimated that eliminating the tax would cost anywhere between $8-12 billion. She says it’s possible by eliminating waste, making government more efficient and modernization

You can hear Crouch speak to Abdul Hakim-Shabazz here (https://indypolitics.org/axing-the-income-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) or by clicking the button below.
ARTICLE (https://indypolitics.org/axing-the-income-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Kosciusko Right To Life Banquet
------------------------------------------------------------
I kicked off the week with a powerful evening at the Kosciusko Right To Life Banquet. My commitment to preserving our pro-life principles is unwavering. I firmly believe that every life is sacred and merits protection. It is not only a moral imperative but also a reflection of our deeply held Hoosier values.

** Hoosier Conservative Voices
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I had the pleasure of speaking with Hoosier Conservative Voices in South Bend on Tuesday about our shared commitment to protecting the unborn and upholding our Constitutional principles, including free speech and ballot integrity. Let's keep Indiana true to its conservative values!

** Luncheon with the Liberty Belles
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Had an enriching discussion with the Liberty Belles in Hamilton County on Wednesday.

Special thanks to this wonderful group of republican women for the great conversations and the awesome shirt — that just so happens to be my favorite color, red!

** Celebrate Life Banquet hosted by Right to Life of Indianapolis
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

At Wednesday night's Celebrate Life Banquet, I️ had the privilege of speaking with Hoosiers from all walks of life who share our commitment to defending the unborn, supporting mothers, and ensuring that every life has the opportunity to thrive.

Right to Life of Indianapolis is at the forefront of this vital work. They have been tireless advocates for the cause, and I'm honored to stand with them in this fight.

** Elkhart County Lincoln Day Dinner
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friday evening took me to the Elkhart County Lincoln Day Dinner, where I had the opportunity to connect with fellow Republicans and share my vision for Indiana's future.

It's always a pleasure to be in Elkhart County!

** Super Saturday Door Knocking
------------------------------------------------------------
Saturday was a full day of engaging with the people of Indiana. In the morning, our team embarked on a Super Saturday Door Knocking event in Indianapolis. Meeting Hoosiers at their doorsteps and listening to their concerns is at the heart of our campaign.

** Fulton County Lincoln Day Dinner
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

On Saturday night, I had the honor of speaking at the Fulton County Lincoln Day Dinner.

The warmth and enthusiasm of the Fulton County Republicans were truly heartening.

** Last Week's Endorsements
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

"I'm proud to endorse my good friend, Lt. Governor Suzanne Crouch, for Governor. I've worked closely with Suzanne over the past 13 years. Suzanne demonstrates what a true public servant of the people is. She is experienced in all aspects of government."

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

"Lt. Governor Suzanne Crouch has presented passion for the people of Indiana in striving for excellence in many aspects over the years. Her ambition presents a strong desire to go above and beyond in achieving the goals for Indiana’s future. I fully endorse her candidacy for Governor of Indiana.”
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

"I am proud to endorse Suzanne Crouch for Governor of Indiana. Suzanne is a great example of a hardworking Hoosier who possess the proper work ethic and desire to lead Indiana to an even brighter future. Suzanne started her career at the county level as Auditor and has continued to work at making the lives of Hoosiers better. I greatly appreciate her grass roots approach to learning what problems we have at the county level and respect for our opinions to fix the problem. I believe Suzanne Crouch is the right person to serve Indiana as Governor."

https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

"Suzanne has a unique way of connecting with people in all walks of life. She makes everyone feel comfortable from young mothers to world leaders. She is extremely qualified to be Governor."
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

"Beyond a doubt, Suzanne Crouch is the most qualified person to run for Governor of the state of Indiana. Suzanne is experienced in all levels of government in Indiana, from township to state government. She works tirelessly to represent the people of Indiana. Please join me in endorsing and voting for Suzanne Crouch as our next Governor."

** Last but not least...
------------------------------------------------------------

I am immensely grateful for the outpouring of support from all of you. Our campaign is fueled by your dedication and belief in a brighter future for Indiana. Together, we can preserve our conservative values, promote economic growth, and ensure the prosperity of our great state.

As we continue on this journey, I encourage you to stay engaged and spread the word about our campaign. We have a long road ahead, but with your support, we can make a positive difference for all Hoosiers.

Onward and upward,

** Get Involved!
------------------------------------------------------------
Ready to make an impact? By joining my campaign, there are several ways that YOU can be a catalyst for change! Tap the "Get Involved" button below to get hands-on with the campaign, request yard signs, host an event and more.
GET INVOLVED (https://crouchforindiana.com/get-involved/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Join me at one of my upcoming fundraisers!
------------------------------------------------------------
For more information or to RSVP, contact Heather at:
heather@crouchforindiana.com (mailto:heather@crouchforindiana.com) or 615-438-3531 (tel:6154383531) .

** Show Your Support - Get Suzanne Crouch Merchandise!
------------------------------------------------------------

As our campaign gains momentum, I'm excited to introduce a way for you to show your support and wear your pride for Indiana on your sleeve (literally)!
SHOP (https://shop.crouchforindiana.com?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=fea3d37900-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_21_04_55&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-fea3d37900-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

The warmth and enthusiasm of the Fulton County Republicans were truly heartening. Last Week's Endorsements "I'm proud to endorse my good friend, Lt. Governor Suzanne Crouch, for Governor. I've worked closely with Suzanne over the past 13 years. Suzanne demonstrates what a true public servant of the people is. She is experienced in all aspects of government." "Lt. Governor Suzanne Crouch has presented passion for the people of Indiana in striving for excellence in many aspects over the years. Her ambition presents a strong desire to go above and beyond in achieving the goals for Indiana’s future. I fully endorse her candidacy for Governor of Indiana.” "I am proud to endorse Suzanne Crouch for Governor of Indiana. Suzanne is a great example of a hardworking Hoosier who possess the proper work ethic and desire to lead Indiana to an even brighter future. Suzanne started her career at the county level as Auditor and has continued to work at making the lives of Hoosiers better. I greatly appreciate her grass roots approach to learning what problems we have at the county level and respect for our opinions to fix the problem. I believe Suzanne Crouch is the right person to serve Indiana as Governor." "Suzanne has a unique way of connecting with people in all walks of life. She makes everyone feel comfortable from young mothers to world leaders. She is extremely qualified to be Governor." "Beyond a doubt, Suzanne Crouch is the most qualified person to run for Governor of the state of Indiana. Suzanne is experienced in all levels of government in Indiana, from township to state government. She works tirelessly to represent the people of Indiana. Please join me in endorsing and voting for Suzanne Crouch as our next Governor." Last but not least... I am immensely grateful for the outpouring of support from all of you. Our campaign is fueled by your dedication and belief in a brighter future for Indiana. Together, we can preserve our conservative values, promote economic growth, and ensure the prosperity of our great state. As we continue on this journey, I encourage you to stay engaged and spread the word about our campaign. We have a long road ahead, but with your support, we can make a positive difference for all Hoosiers. Onward and upward, Get Involved! Ready to make an impact? By joining my campaign, there are several ways that YOU can be a catalyst for change! Tap the "Get Involved" button below to get hands-on with the campaign, request yard signs, host an event and more. GET INVOLVED () Join me at one of my upcoming fundraisers! For more information or to RSVP, contact Heather at: heather@crouchforindiana.com (mailto:heather@crouchforindiana.com) or 615-438-3531 (tel:6154383531) . Show Your Support - Get Suzanne Crouch Merchandise! Friend,
It’s hard to believe that it’s already been around a month since I launched my campaign for the U.S. Senate here in Florida. It’s been a whirlwind of meeting voters, hearing from supporters like you, and spreading our message of progress and unity.
Now, we’re rapidly approaching our first end-of-quarter deadline. This is the biggest moment of our campaign yet. Our fundraising numbers are about to become public for the first time — and all eyes will be on us.
This is our chance to prove the strength of our movement to Rick Scott, the pundits, the GOP’s megadonors, and the people of Florida. That’s why I’ve set an ambitious $350,000 goal — and I’m counting on your help to hit it. Please, will you split a donation between Serve America and my campaign before midnight tonight to help us hit our end-of-quarter goal so that we can pull ahead in the polls? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Thanks to grassroots Democrats like you, we have the momentum advantage — a new poll shows that this race is already tied!
As I look back on these past few weeks, I’m filled with so much gratitude for supporters like you. But I also have to be realistic about what we’re up against here.
Rick Scott and his far-right megadonors are prepared to launch even more attacks against our campaign. And if they see any sign of weakness in our public fundraising numbers, they won’t hesitate to destroy our momentum.
I’m in this race to fight for the issues that matter to families like yours — protecting Social Security and Medicare, ending gun violence, restoring reproductive rights, strengthening voting rights, and more. I promise you that I will always have your back in Washington. But today, I need you to have mine.
Please, will you split $20 between Serve America and me to flip Florida blue and defend our Senate majority? I can only defeat Rick Scott and his personal fortune if people like you stand with me. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for all that you’ve done to get our campaign started on the strongest foot possible.
With immense gratitude,

This is our chance to prove the strength of our movement to Rick Scott, the pundits, the GOP’s megadonors, and the people of Florida. I've been running this campaign since day one against what's expected. We're not a traditional campaign, we're so much MORE.

First, the good news: When I first started this campaign, I had never run for public office before. Most Republican voters didn't know me. I didn't have the “benefit” of being a former Vice President, Ambassador, or Governor. **Yet, I am polling above all of the career politicians in New Hampshire.**

Now for the bad news - _**I have a target on my back from the Establishment.**_

I've been running this campaign since day one against what's expected. We're not a traditional campaign, we're so much **_MORE_**.

Since I am not counting on DC insiders to fund this campaign, I need you.

**[Will you chip in $8- _to recognize our huge gains in New Hampshire_ - or more?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678746%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lVaor35h2c9EcMd%2bmVbA5Q&sysid=1)**

---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm43d77camlsflrebse8jh5cr8868r1gf2mem4po_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdhm6or4cph2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlbce7753kngkn7ljcht7s00ajr02c1kk312ogp0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdhm6or4cph2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zljti2t0qiq0ooiu6fr28m3fgadpo2nk3n767lr0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdhm6or4cph2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqvlnrr80ceq3qaqohpeb8v3p70mobppqs2v6hvg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdhm6or4cph2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America. Thank you for your consideration. subject: ALERT: Bost, LaHood Vote for More Ukrainian War Funding, As Budget Showdown Looms
body:
As our Southern Border continues to see the largest illegal crossings of all time, two of our Illinois Congressmen seek to fortify Ukraine's border.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/48c556b75357/alert-bost-lahood-vote-for-more-ukrainian-war-funding-as-budget-showdown-looms?e=1cb5fdae9e)
https://illinoisreview.com?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Illinois Review eBlast Powered By
https://kasparlaw.co/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

As U.S. Border Patrol Announces Highest Monthly Total for Illegal Crossings at the Southern Border, IL Congressmen Bost, LaHood Vote to Send Millions More to Ukraine (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/as-u-s-border-patrol-announces-highest-monthly-total-for-illegal-crossings-at-the-southern-border-il-congressmen-bost-lahood-vote-to-send-millions-more-to-ukraine.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/as-u-s-border-patrol-announces-highest-monthly-total-for-illegal-crossings-at-the-southern-border-il-congressmen-bost-lahood-vote-to-send-millions-more-to-ukraine.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Illegal aliens arrive via freight train to the United States last week, as the U.S. Customs and Border Patrol publishes the largest numbers ever of illegal border crossings. (Source: Reuters)
By Scott Kaspar, Publisher

On Friday, the Washington Examiner (https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/policy/immigration/biden-august-border-record-illegal-crossing-attempts?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) broke the news that August saw the highest number ever of illegal crossing attempts at America’s Southern Border. More than 304,000 people were apprehended by Border Patrol last month at the Southern Border, according to data published (https://www.cbp.gov/newsroom/stats/nationwide-encounters?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) Friday by U.S. Customs and Border Patrol.

That’s as much as 10 times the monthly apprehensions that occurred during Trump’s presidency.

Even Elon Musk
posted (https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1705365182661161225?s=20&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) his shock about Biden’s latest record.
https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1705365182661161225?s=20&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
The news comes at the same time when Speaker Kevin McCarthy, R-CA is struggling to find the votes to pass a rules package necessary to keep the federal government open. The bone of contention: a defense appropriations bill that includes $300M for securing not our own border but another country’s border—Ukraine.

Last Thursday, the vote
failed (https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/house/house-gop-defectors-defense-spending?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in the House, with defectors citing the Ukraine funding as the reason. “Our country is being invaded by thousands every damn day and our Department of Defense does nothing,” stated Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene, R-GA.
https://x.com/RepMTG/status/1704890019284988086?s=20&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Greene’s sentiments were shared by Illinois Republican Congresswoman Mary Miller, IL-15, who posted: “I oppose sending money to Ukraine that will be stolen by Ukrainian oligarchs in a proxy war that we were dragged into because Ukraine was paying the Biden family $1 million a year in cash. We should be securing our southern border instead!”
https://twitter.com/Miller_Congress/status/1704861104524902504?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1704861104524902504%7Ctwgr%5Ed45b2d5e0c30be3668be29627d0591ddbf4e5c6e%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.illinoisreview.com%2Fillinoisreview%2F2023%2F09%2Fas-u-s-border-patrol-announces-highest-monthly-total-for-illegal-crossings-at-the-southern-border-il-congressmen-bost-lahood-vote-to-send-millions-more-to-ukraine.html&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Illinois’ other two Republican Congressmen, Darin LaHood, IL-16 and Mike Bost, IL-12 voted in favor of sending millions of dollars more to Ukraine.

Bost, a former Marine who chairs the Veterans Affairs committee, has been remarkably quiet about his support for Ukraine. Bost is being challenged in the Republican primary by former Republican gubernatorial candidate Darren Bailey.

On Friday, Bailey posted a list of Republicans including Bost and LaHood who voted to send more money to Ukraine.
https://x.com/DarrenBaileyIL/status/1705392674210254881?s=20&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
LaHood, who recently had a fundraiser in Chicago that attracted much of the IL GOP establishment elite, is running in an uncontested primary. This past September 11th, LaHood arrived with Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis at the 9/11 Memorial in New York City, leading many to speculate that LaHood is quietly supporting DeSantis’ presidential campaign.
https://x.com/aaronlarnavarro/status/1701206882306633850?s=20&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Florida Republican Congressman Matt Gaetz, who has endorsed President Trump for the presidential nomination, is calling on Speaker McCarthy to separate the Ukrainian war funding into a stand-alone bill, or else face a motion to vacate his speakership.
https://twitter.com/RealAmVoice/status/1704167510382161928?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1704167510382161928%7Ctwgr%5E3bc8530141747e659922eeb98987139adb345116%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.illinoisreview.com%2Fillinoisreview%2F2023%2F09%2Fas-u-s-border-patrol-announces-highest-monthly-total-for-illegal-crossings-at-the-southern-border-il-congressmen-bost-lahood-vote-to-send-millions-more-to-ukraine.html&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Trump has been anything but silent on the war in Ukraine, vowing to quickly end it should he be reelected to the presidency in 2024. On Friday, Trump encouraged Republicans in Congress to “use the power of the purse” to secure our own border.
https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/111100463579415723?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
An ABC-Washington Post poll (https://www.newsmax.com/politics/poll-donald-trump-joe-biden/2023/09/24/id/1135686/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) released Sunday shows that Trump continues to dominate the race for the Republican presidential nomination but also now leads Biden by 10 points.
https://youtu.be/axCuEVapA-s?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Editor-in-Chief Mark Vargas on Newsmax discussing Chicago crime and City-run grocery stores.
https://illinoisreview.com?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=47508f6ef5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_25_03_09&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-47508f6ef5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

| | We strongly believe in building power from the ground up and know that the people who are closest to a problem often have the best understanding of how to fix it. As such, **we devote the month of August to****paying homage to Black revolutionaries** , **incarcerated freedom fighters, and Black resistance****–****historical and ongoing****–****by encouraging Black-led organizations to apply for Movement Labs' in-kind grants program. This grants program aims to uplift movement-building work in historically marginalized communities.** This year, we're excited to provide grants to 10 organizations! These advocates and activists are working in critical areas including:
* Driving up Black voter registrations and voter turnout in critical battleground states like Florida;
* Building up a new bench of young Black and Brown candidates to run for local office in their hometowns; and
* Bringing under-served groups like immigrants and the formerly incarcerated into the civic and activist spaces in their communities.

clean_body: | | | | We strongly believe in building power from the ground up and know that the people who are closest to a problem often have the best understanding of how to fix it. As such, we devote the month of August topaying homage to Black revolutionaries , incarcerated freedom fighters, and Black resistance–historical and ongoing–by encouraging Black-led organizations to apply for Movement Labs' in-kind grants program. This grants program aims to uplift movement-building work in historically marginalized communities. This year, we're excited to provide grants to 10 organizations! These advocates and activists are working in critical areas including: Driving up Black voter registrations and voter turnout in critical battleground states like Florida; Building up a new bench of young Black and Brown candidates to run for local office in their hometowns; and Bringing under-served groups like immigrants and the formerly incarcerated into the civic and activist spaces in their communities. = Donate Now If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = ---|--- = | = = Movement Labs' grantees receive in-kind text banking services, strategic consulting, and access to digital organizing tools that will help them do community outreach, recruit new members, fundraise, host events and trainings, and communicate with elected officials. = We are eager to see what our grantee organizations do this year and can't thank you enough for helping us to support them! In case you missed it, last week President Joe Biden announced that he’s creating a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. This is a major action that we’ve been working towards for years.

And with the help of grassroots supporters like you — chipping in and sharing our message when you can — we’ve made it clear: **they’re right to be scared.**
Just a few days after we launched this campaign, _National Journal_ said our race “represents one of the Democratic Party’s better offensive targets” in 2024.
And since then, we’ve made that a reality by breaking Missouri fundraising records and building a truly people-powered coalition to take back this Senate seat with support from the Missouri AFL-CIO, the Missouri Fire Fighters, former statewide leaders like Joe Maxwell and Susan Montee, and local elected officials and community leaders all across the state. **Polling shows we’ve even managed to put this race in a dead heat!**
That’s why GOP insiders and corporate mega-donors put more than **$1 MILLION** into a brand new Super PAC to attack me — and it’s why national Republicans are dumping money into Josh Hawley’s campaign.
They know that Hawley is the most vulnerable GOP senator up for re-election next year — **with even worse approval ratings than Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida.** And they can tell we’re putting together a powerful grassroots movement that’s capable of winning this race, flipping this U.S. Senate seat, and taking back power for real working people.

We’ll stop handing out money for Wall Street and forever wars, and start rebuilding communities in Missouri and all across the country. And we’ll create the next generation of energy jobs right here at home.
That’s what we’re fighting for in this movement. And I’m glad you’re a part of it.
Now let’s get moving,
Lucas Kunce

subject: Don’t just read about my vision for America– WATCH IT.
body:

Friend,

It's Nikki Haley here, and with the second debate just less than a week away, I want to take a moment to share my story and my vision for a strong and proud America with you.

**Throughout my life, I have dedicated myself to standing for America and defending the values she was founded on.** This commitment has been at the core of everything I've done, whether it was during my time as South Carolina's governor or while representing America on the global stage at the United Nations. I firmly believe that these values are the foundation of our great nation, and I am determined to uphold them as your next President of the United States.

**But to truly grasp my vision for America, I invite you to see it for yourself:**
| | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23149%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QGU%2fSmuljjk6DbzKUPJ%2fwA&sysid=1)

| | [WATCH NOW](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23140%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZmGYN4f5mMSQa0K%2bmn057g&sysid=1)
---

I hope that as you watch, you'll see the same America I see--an America that is strong, proud, and full of opportunities.

Now, more than ever, our country needs unity, resilience, and a leader who is unwavering in their commitment to these ideals that make us great. To turn this vision into reality, I need your support. **[Whether you can contribute $1 or $100, your support will make a significant impact on our journey to getting our country back on track.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23141%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CM0bDB48asSnD4QppwmNCA&sysid=1 "Whether you can contribute
$1 or $100, your support will make a significant impact on our journey to getting
our country back on track.")**

Your support today will play a crucial role in advancing our shared vision for America. Together, we can make our country strong and proud.

Thank you in advance for your support. We have a country to save, and having you by my side makes an important difference.
---

My very best,

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23256%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ASRo6zOYTIekmBw4KMPi0A&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and
help me save our country?")**

I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. And I’ll do it as your next President. As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard-working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard-working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard-working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | Most importantly, I am running for president because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. Peter, we can’t trust Big Tech to self-regulate when it comes to AI. [Urge Congress to regulate AI before it’s too late - click here to sign on.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb322a74b-a5d5-4f51-99d0-1160632c1ecb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Peter, From ChatGPT to Google Bard, all the buzz right now is about generative AI, a form of artificial intelligence that can create words, sounds, images, and video, sometimes at a level of sophistication that mimics human creativity. [1] AI has the potential for good, but we’re already seeing its harms playout: Chatbots spreading misinformation, validating heinous conspiracy theories, creating propaganda, and even encouraging children to engage in predatory situations with adults. [2] [As one of the leading organizations that advocates for transparency, accountability, and oversight of Big Tech giants, Accountable Tech is sounding the alarm. Please join us and urge Congress to regulate AI before it renders serious harm to our society and democracy. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf7a57a95-f5bb-447f-a6a2-4716ad6764ae/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Just a few months ago, Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI and the creator of ChatGPT, told Congress he supports government regulation of AI. [3] He later lobbied against the EU’s proposed AI Act claiming it was “overregulating.” [4] Then recently, all the Big Tech CEOs met with Congress to help write the rules for AI and claim they support regulation. [5] Peter, we’ve seen this playbook before from Facebook, Google, Microsoft, and other Big Tech companies calling for regulation while running multi-million-dollar campaigns to defeat it. Last year alone, Big Tech spent $230 million to defeat bipartisan antitrust legislation that would have reined in their monopoly powers. [6] Congress has a history of leaving new technologies unregulated until it's too late. [We can’t let that happen with AI – the risks are too high. Please join us and urge Congress to create real accountability and transparency for new AI technologies.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6134d41f-8966-4e68-897f-452336f5a208/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We can’t trust Big Tech to write their own rules with AI. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Peter – James Carville here.

There are two things I know for certain about Kentucky: their bourbon is the best and so is their governor.

I've been in politics for a long time, so I know the real deal when I see it. Andy Beshear is the real deal. Andy's not afraid to put politics to the side to do what's best for Kentuckians. That's why he's the most popular Democratic governor in the entire country.

But Peter – I also know that Andy has an uphill battle ahead of him. He won in 2019 by just over 5,000 votes and we can bet it'll be another close race this year. That's why I'm reaching out today.

[**Will you chip in before Andy's end-of-quarter deadline to help him win this tough race? **If you can’t join ‘em, beat ‘em**
Today, I’d like to discuss the Republican party’s concentration on “vote harvesting,” “chasing ballots,” “banking votes,” and what it means for the 2024 elections.
For reference:
* _vote harvesting_ \- collecting and voting ballots that are not yours; long-running practice by the DNC, now the RNC is following suit. [Here’s a look at ballot harvesting laws by state. ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/TSJrbp_ITb99OtMH475Js5-259FXeXNRNF6_dNGLr12YbLhGa3EP28hibW0I1n3CJgnHnZh_FXhX-H8PSJDMv3baF6e7-U6NDC_rv1K7F5O9Jnj95UVHLVm-ZBk0O_agB_er1AXtrex7Y99kg-sRlfoSzQs4c5Nf_wJjcEdI91hG-zpBJNZNn1rYoF3K_KX4o4S8odDXobqUzId4FQxqlA8653SFEWrw92o18VZ6GHs/3zw/ASS1LLMVSNSBDGC2EidWbg/h1/quGx4RWdiJS1aaFHKdj8VURCGpVWuBxULdrUoUX_YeQ)

* _chasing ballots_ \- identifying households where registered voters have not yet voted and monitoring them, “chasing” them until they vote. This term seems to be lessening in popularity.

* _banking votes_ \- a new term conceived by the RNC, calling on Republicans to commit to vote early or by mail, thereby “banking” votes before election day. The RNC asks all voters to pledge to “bank your vote with the RNC”.

I am regularly asked what I think about the Republicans’ new _“if you can’t beat ‘em, join ‘em”_ mentality. Here’s what I think:
I think the uniparty is real. I believe that many, thankfully not all, but many, of our national and state elected, and the party apparatuses that support them, are no longer vying for the traditional victory of R’s or D’s, but rather for a kind of sweeping, suffocating, power by any means.
This mechanistic disregard for the individual can been seen on both sides. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. This year, Governor DeSantis signed: Record tax relief ESG prohibitions Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation. | Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

Peter, Abortion is on the ballot this year in Virginia. Republican Governor Glenn Youngkin tried — and failed — to ban abortion after 15 weeks in the state, but couldn’t get it through a Democratic-controlled Senate. Now, he’s vowed to try again if Republicans take back the state legislature in just a few weeks. Republicans are going all out to win in Virginia, even initiating a cyber attack against Susanna Gibson meant to shame and humiliate her by publicizing intimate details of her private life — not at all dissimilar from what happened to Katie. Tate used our taxpayer-funded state airplane to attend political events around the country, collect campaign checks, and clink glasses with his rich and powerful cronies.
Think about it. Mississippians are stuck footing the bill for Tate to travel the country and live the high life.
That's taxpayer dollars that could've been put to better use, like supporting our underfunded schools, investing in another hospital, or building essential infrastructure to uplift our rural communities.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70327497/429036386/974620941?refcode=ea.9a785265-cd5b-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ms=ea.9a785265-cd5b-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzMTAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWE3ODUyNjUtY2Q1Yi1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WHnKhAt8Wn7nbieRvoTRjery_UVsh_UQnxKn8OtbwtE=)

And let's not forget, he's knee-deep in Mississippi's worst-ever public corruption scandal for the misuse of our taxpayer money. Even Reeves’ personal trainer received $1.3 million. (With that kind of cash, you’d expect Tate to have golden six-pack abs).

Friends,
The Radical Left learned long ago that the way to create generational change was to take over education and begin indoctrinating our children at a young age. In doing so, they've taken away the rights of parents to raise their kids in the way they wish, while forcing them into a crappy education in government-run schools.
Freedom Caucuses are fighting back against the left-wing indoctrination agenda and we saw some incredible wins this year in all 11 of our states for educational freedom and parental rights.
* Arizona Democrat Gov. Katie Hobbs campaigned on defunding the state's school choice program. It was THE top target by the state's Democrat elite. Fortunately, the **Arizona Freedom Caucus** was able to use its leverage in budget negotiations, which ultimately protected the school choice program while giving taxpayers much needed tax relief. A liberal columnist who hates that the AZ Freedom Caucus won on school choice [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/ae6687f8-9d20-4756-a82e-2adf1c6921c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "Freedom Caucusers were all smiles on Monday and for good reason."
* Our **Illinois** and **Pennsylvania Freedom Caucuses** are making news as we speak. Both of them recently called on their respective state GOP parties to ban Republican lawmakers from taking cash from teachers' unions. Illinois and Pennsylvania both have modest school choice programs that are under attack by the Democrats in charge. But dozens of Republican lawmakers are complicit because the teachers' unions bankroll their campaigns. That has to stop. More on this in the weeks to come.
* The **Idaho Freedom Caucus** successfully led the effort to require the State Department of Education to prohibit diversity statements when hiring at Idaho's four-year public college and universities. One wonders how many professors previously were denied a job because their "diversity statement" wasn't woke enough.
* Following attempts by both students and liberal state lawmakers to cancel three events hosted by conservative student groups at the University of Pittsburgh, the **Pennsylvania Freedom Caucus** publicly stood against the bans and introduced the "Free Speech in Higher Education" bill to protect the first amendment on college campuses.
* Our **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** successfully sponsored and passed a bill that changed the definition of a "home-based educational program" in the state to allow multi-family homeschool settings. This encourages even more families to homeschool their children with less red tape.

Finally, let's discuss some truly crazy stuff that happened on parental rights that a couple of our states stopped:
* During the COVID years, a local sheriff in Idaho threatened to take kids away from parents if they didn't get them vaccinated. **Our Idaho Freedom Caucus** introduced a bill earlier this year and got it swiftly passed that prohibits all investigations and court orders terminating a parent's relationship with their child based on their immunization status.
* Our **Louisiana Freedom Caucus** successfully authored and passed a bill that requires parents be notified if a teacher uses a pronoun for a child other than the sex recorded on the child's birth certificate.

These success stories are very real and undeniable. Imagine what we could do if we had a Freedom Caucus in all 50 states! If you share our vision and want to support our efforts, please donate now.

**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**
