for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.

I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas.

_**But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.**_

[**Will you help my son?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1kotfcu88t80nndqi4eg2dc3e320t8ujoo9hk30_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs)

That's Michael in the photo.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zusq8nr5qiak6v60tduate6k76fi0nlgjfp48sag_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs) [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2f6htrbqmpstsmb126vtj7jvg2hnps0mtobni18_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs)

In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve.

I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job.

Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty.

It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years.

What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need.

I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist.

Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats.

Fear of losing their jobs.

I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back.

**But I was wrong.**

_So_ _now_ _Michael 's_ _life_ _is_ _at_ _stake_ _for_ _simply_ _doing_ _his_ _job_ _and_ _we_ _have_ _nobody_ _to_ _turn_ _to_ _except_ _for_ _good_ _hearted_ _strangers_ _like_ _you._

**[Will you please help me save my son Michael?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkv34np60rqsvu8k82a5r7ou134cmn7m1mavpbn0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs)**

Let me give you some more of the details...

Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade."

The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police.

Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man.

When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car.

The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him.

Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired.

The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene.

My son suffered back and leg injuries.

Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck.

In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community.

There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day.

He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others.

But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years.

Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did?

That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. **[Even if that means asking folks like you for financial support to help my son afford the best possible attorneys and legal advice.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2s6usvo48sivbusufgfqbrs1fjrhjofi9jcq8l8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs)**

After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died.

But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified.

And then our whole world was rocked.

**Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted.**

Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said:

"We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never."

I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court.

We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense.

After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser.

They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" \- and helping him violated their terms of service.

So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds.

No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process.

Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime."

Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael.

_With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading._

Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). **LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have.**

LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.

The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.

And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son!

**[Will you please consider sending a tax-deductible contribution to the LELDF so they can help my son beat his charges?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z49nefe2rjkfffs7o14ocnirajgi4ddu72f14r20_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs)**

You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers.

Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a **[gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more,](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z40t0vbc6vgndqcgg4h8amt2s630of7nracjuruo_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs)** I pray you will consider doing so.

Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing.

If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers.

My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvg2bjqrnkliutmhosv6itf7b1hshphvbd0agpng_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs)
_That 's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn_
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmfh6t992jsig81dqgb5vkb2q08nfivjonq4pogg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs)
_That 's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William_

I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today.

Sincerely,

Margaret Mary Dunn

PS: LELDF relies on caring people like you to send donations so they can fight tooth and nail to help wrongly-accused police officers like Michael. And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind **[donation today of $35, $50, or $100](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1i94osc2qf3vdn88mjfd3iestedh1ulsbc2m50g_rp22sh2s8i66p75cdge0oj0clh2bs)** to help Michael will mean so much to my family.

\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

name: Rob Flaherty (via JoeBiden.com)
subject: A note on Wednesday’s debate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Biden for President
body:
The GOP candidates are fighting for MAGA extremism. Joe Biden is fighting for progress. | | |
---
Hi, Peter -- it’s Rob Flaherty, Deputy Campaign Manager for the Biden-Harris 2024 campaign. The second Republican Presidential Primary Debate is this Wednesday. In case you didn’t watch the first one (and honestly, if you didn’t: Good for you), it made something pretty clear: **We have no time to waste.** Last month’s debate showed us that if you give any of these candidates a microphone, that they’re going to say some wacky stuff. They all hold extreme, MAGA views and they weren’t afraid to show it. And they even went after each other. Call it the narcissism of little difference. **But here’s the thing: All they’re looking to do is distract folks from the fact that they’ve got no plan to move this country forward. ---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/mansharamani/p/the-student-loan-repayment-bomb?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store)
---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/17cfae60-5e67-4167-8b49-36c526a24e0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Regulators, policymakers, and analysts alike have been warning about outstanding student debt levels for years. Years before the pandemic, [Federal Reserve chair Jerome Powell had noted that student debt might restrict a borrower's ability to start a business, finance a home purchase, or participate fully in the economy](https://substack.com/redirect/d3af678c-9268-40fb-a42a-3fb3ea7ecfa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In 2018, for instance, when student loan balances were ~$500 billion less than today, he warned if "[student loans continue to grow and become larger and larger, then it absolutely could hold back growth](https://substack.com/redirect/d3af678c-9268-40fb-a42a-3fb3ea7ecfa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
[Student debt has ballooned to $1.8 trillion](https://substack.com/redirect/8be5ff06-7d97-427c-8446-005e58124435?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2023 ([93% of which are federal student loans](https://substack.com/redirect/27acfe35-eb07-4d58-9c49-0bd3ee67982c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) and is now the second largest form of borrowing by US households behind mortgages. It's almost double the $[1 trillion of that American consumers had on their credit cards](https://substack.com/redirect/14e144c1-20ea-47a1-9abc-ed1d8bf25790?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and significantly more than than the[ $1.5 trillion in debt used to purchase an automobile](https://substack.com/redirect/d096e1c3-432c-4b8a-adc1-5da63dbbe7db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And household debt (including mortgages and home equity lines of credit) currently totals over $17 trillion, a record level. Inflation, of course, has been a major contributing factor to all debt balances, as consumers borrowed increasingly larger sums to finance the rapidly rising prices of cars, homes, and educations.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..VNTEN64FXd-2hBWE7upEquUmzJShwtoJMT50YtS8nik?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=137353679)
The idea behind student loans was sound. "Borrow money, invest in yourself, and your post-education income gains will more than offset the cost of the loans" was the logic. And for many students, that was indeed the case. But as tuitions rose far more rapidly than inflation, and the number of students seeking educational opportunities rose, the economic return for many students fell below the cost of debt. Prior to the pandemic, student debt delinquencies were consistently above 10%, many times higher than those for mortgages or automobiles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a8d8b996-74cd-4730-b080-de311920ff55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Data from **December 2019** ; Source: [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/12/28/how-student-debt-came-to-define-peoples-lives-in-the-2010s.html](https://substack.com/redirect/f7cc7122-207e-432c-8b88-e86e5f791d7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
During the pandemic, in a quest to support consumers in the midst of a potential economic collapse, [the Department of Education (ED) reduced the interest rate for qualifying student loans to 0% from March 13, 2020 through August 31, 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/66dbd570-e62a-4e85-b3ec-61095c58d1df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Further, all borrowers were also granted an ["administrative forbearance" that paused any required payments until October 1, 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/66dbd570-e62a-4e85-b3ec-61095c58d1df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Unsurprisingly, student loan delinquencies fell to almost zero while the delinquency rates for credit cards and automobiles have reverted to pre-pandemic levels. This led to improving credit scores for many borrowers, a dynamic that enabled them to borrow even more money.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..VNTEN64FXd-2hBWE7upEquUmzJShwtoJMT50YtS8nik?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=137353679)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bf73d852-74b2-4318-95ea-bbdad6d1e48e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://www.newyorkfed.org/medialibrary/Interactives/householdcredit/data/pdf/HHDC_2023Q2.pdf](https://substack.com/redirect/5c098fe2-1431-4b37-b7e6-7d5073a73bd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Further, because of how many mortgage issuers calculate creditworthiness and debt-to-income ratios (thanks to Obama-era income-based student loan repayment schemes), [many also believe the student loan bubble helped inflate a housing bubble](https://substack.com/redirect/5c0ca869-b32b-4ab3-81ae-d55b3b9aad7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). A recent _Wall Street Journal_ article provided a clear example:
> _[Take a couple with two kids that earns $75,000 a year and has $100,000 of student-loan debt. Under a standard repayment plan, they would have to pay about $1,150 per month. Under the Obama plans they would have to pay only about $250. If they apply for a mortgage, only $250 would be counted toward their debt-to-income ratio.](https://substack.com/redirect/5c0ca869-b32b-4ab3-81ae-d55b3b9aad7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
> _[This would enable them to qualify for mortgages with monthly payments $900 larger than they otherwise could if they were paying down their student loans in full. At today's interest rates, they would qualify for a roughly $120,000 larger mortgage.](https://substack.com/redirect/5c0ca869-b32b-4ab3-81ae-d55b3b9aad7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
As the policies which allowed borrowers to forego required repayments end, the implications for the US economy are not good. Simple math can help us guesstimate the impact. To calculate the annual interest owed on student debt, let's conservatively assume a 5% rate (many loans are above this level): $1.8 trillion times 5% = $90 billion. In addition to interest, borrowers need to repay principal, which suggests that [the 43.6 million consumers who have federal student loans](https://substack.com/redirect/27acfe35-eb07-4d58-9c49-0bd3ee67982c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) will need to divert [at least $100 billion annually from buying goods and services to repaying debt](https://substack.com/redirect/6842b01b-1b98-41ff-b40f-620062587563?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..VNTEN64FXd-2hBWE7upEquUmzJShwtoJMT50YtS8nik?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=137353679)
Perhaps this is why the Biden administration tried to forgive more than $400 billion of debt. In August 2022, "[President Biden told federal student loan borrowers that the U.S. government would cancel up to $20,000 of debt for low income students who had received a Pell Grant to attend college, and up to $10,000 for the vast majority of remaining borrowers](https://substack.com/redirect/835c6756-f694-4b4c-ada4-771fa153577e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." The plan would have been a federal handout to more than [43 million borrowers, or approximately 13% of Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/835c6756-f694-4b4c-ada4-771fa153577e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Several states immediately contested the legality of the Biden plan and the case quickly found its way to the highest court in America. In June 2023, [the Supreme Court of the United States ruled against the Biden-Harris plan to forgive student loan debt for millions of borrowers](https://substack.com/redirect/f70ce0e4-128b-4bde-bdb4-3891ef3e8faf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Student loan repayments are set to restart next month. While it's impossible to know how this development will impact the economy as a whole, it's worth considering a few (of the many) possible implications:
1. It seems highly likely that consumer creditworthiness will fall as student loan delinquencies rise. What will **deteriorating credit** **scores** mean for the ability of consumers to borrow, or the rates at which they can borrow? Is it possible that demand for durable consumer goods plunges? How will this impact **[the current wave of labor unrest](https://substack.com/redirect/3fdbb9ef-df26-41f8-814e-6ee00ef07a69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**?
2. As consumers spend more than $100 billion to repay student debt, will the corresponding **fall in demand for goods and services** be the straw that breaks the economic camel's back? If consumers slow spending enough to meaningfully impact business profits, **will unemployment rise?** Could student loan repayments derail the strong labor market?
3. Could the pandemic **housing boom** have been partially driven by student loan forbearance? Will the resumption of student loan repayments put sufficient stress on over leveraged households that **mortgage delinquencies rise** , and might the already fragile real estate market crumble? Are the [rapidly falling home prices in the San Francisco Bay area](https://substack.com/redirect/5c0ca869-b32b-4ab3-81ae-d55b3b9aad7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an early warning indicicator for housing in general?
4. Could a forthcoming recession impact the **US Presidential election of 2024**? A recession during the second half of [President George H. W. Bush's](https://substack.com/redirect/b4bbe811-cb30-44f7-b74c-574c359740c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) first term set the stage for [Bill Clinton's winning campaign that focused on the economy](https://substack.com/redirect/3116cbe1-b8d9-4649-b5cd-378468bc5748?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Might a combination of falling housing prices, a rapidly weakening housing market, and strained household budgets **doom a Biden re-election**?

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bb916131-19b5-488d-9d55-39f195abc404?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Regardless of what transpires, the combination of elevated household debt levels and interest rates that have risen rapidly are a toxic cocktail that could derail the economy. The impact of higher interest rates are rarely felt instantaneously; rather, the higher cost of money hits consumer budgets over time as homeowners move or families replace worn-out durable goods such as cars and appliances. Might our economy be like Wile E. Coyote who has run off a cliff, his feet are still moving, but he has yet to look down? Only time will tell.

name: John Fetterman
subject: Senator Menendez must resign.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Senator Menendez should resign.
#
Derek, you have probably heard about the allegations against Senator Bob Menendez. A lengthy and detailed indictment lays out charges of bribery and of corrupt foreign dealings against the Senator from New Jersey.
Senator Menendez is entitled to the presumption of innocence under our system, but he is not entitled to continue to wield influence over national policy, especially given the serious and specific nature of the allegations.
**He should choose an honorable exit and resign.**
As of right now, it seems as if my colleague is refusing to step down and is continuing to campaign for re-election. But a serious primary challenger, Representative Andy Kim, has announced he'll run against Bob Menendez.
**[So I'm writing this to you today with an unusual request. I'm asking if you'll split a donation between our campaign and Andy Kim. Will you chip in today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230925-1?refcode=em20230925-1-8585&refcode2=8585_434096_ZoHNAR&akid=8585%2E434096%2EZoHNAR)**
This request isn't a traditional political endorsement. **I want to be clear -- I am not endorsing Andy Kim or anyone right now.** But I am committed to ensuring that Senator Menendez has a rigorous primary opponent in case he makes the ill-advised decision to continue running for re-election, for the sake of the people he represents.
We have to root out corruption from our political system, no matter what party these allegations are against.
**[That's why I'm hoping that you split a donation between me and Andy Kim today, because our neighbors in New Jersey deserve a Senator they can trust and believe has the best interests of their constituents as their priority on Capitol Hill.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230925-1?refcode=em20230925-1-8585&refcode2=8585_434096_ZoHNAR&akid=8585%2E434096%2EZoHNAR)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230925-1?amount=5&refcode=em20230925-8585&refcode2=8585_434096_ZoHNAR&akid=8585%2E434096%2EZoHNAR)**
Thanks for your support, Derek.
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator, Pennsylvania

Hear directly from WAGOP Chairman Jim Walsh on these important issues...

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: Trump just attacked us for making voting more accessible in Pennsylvania
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
Derek, Last week, we announced that Pennsylvania is officially an automatic voter registration state. It’s a commonsense change that will help tens of thousands of Pennsylvanians make their voice heard – no matter who you choose to vote for or what your views are. | | Peter, are you angry about the chaos in Congress right now that's pushing us to the brink of a government shutdown? **If you are, I need your help to flip OR-05 from red to blue and take back the House. And with our FEC deadline looming, every donation makes a big difference.**[**Can you pitch in $3 right now to help us meet our goal of 350 donations by September 30?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70331870/429050492/974409837?refcode=2023-09-25-eoq&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=4d6016e0-d75b-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84MzU0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDYwMTZlMC1kNzViLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lLBybgXYpLCAg4ab5DJPW2JCdQOp5MxdKs35bS7z2c4=) [Donate Today](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70331873/429050499/974409837?refcode=2023-09-25-eoq&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=4d6016e0-d75b-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84MzU0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDYwMTZlMC1kNzViLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lLBybgXYpLCAg4ab5DJPW2JCdQOp5MxdKs35bS7z2c4=) **I'm always one who likes numbers to explain things, so let me present a simple number: five.** House Republicans have a five-seat majority right now, and they owe it to members like Lori Chavez-DeRemer. Chavez-DeRemer and other members who flipped swing districts in 2022 ran as "sensible" Republicans. But they voted to give Kevin McCarthy the Speaker's gavel and to let MAGA extremists run key committees. They gave cover to the GOP majority – a majority that was inevitably going to bring things to where we are today. HEADLINES: BIG NEWS! Barbara Lee for Senate! | Progressives Rally for

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9759?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1011&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]It’s only because of our grassroots supporters that we’re able to
organize — and win. Please chip in to our Progressive Power Fund to make
sure we hit the ground running in 2024!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9759?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1012&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1013&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

The 2024 election season is officially underway, and the progressive
movement will be pivotal to defeating Trump and the GOP, taking back the
House, and sending more allies to Bernie Sanders in the Senate to partner
with our movement for change.

That’s why Our Revolution kicked things off in a BIG way this week with
our first major endorsement for 2024 — Barbara Lee to be the next U.S.
Senator from California!

Progressive leaders and the grassroots are rallying behind Barbara, who
joined us for our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9760?t=1014&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]LIVE Town Hall event on Tuesday with U.S. Reps. Ro
Khanna, Cori Bush, Mark Pocan and Ayanna Pressley, Minnesota AG Keith
Ellison!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9762?t=1015&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]READ ALL ABOUT IT IN THE NATION

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1016&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

ELECTING A PROGRESSIVE ICON TO THE SENATE

“At the end of the day, Barbara Lee is the movement candidate,” Our
Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese told [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9762?t=1017&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]The Nation’s John
Nichols in an exclusive interview about our endorsement.

She’s a lifelong organizer who has been in the trenches with working
people from Day 1.

Representative Lee has been ranked the most progressive member of the US
House, she’s been one of the most effective progressives in the country,
and she has stood for what’s right even when she’s had to stand alone.

Many remember Barbara Lee’s lone vote against the War in Afghanistan, and
she has been a constant voice for people, peace, and the planet throughout
her life and career.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1018&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

Barbara Lee comes from the working class and she would be the only black
woman in the Senate. Her lived experience fuels her fight for single moms,
abortion rights, economic justice, and more.

“When I’m elected I’m going to fight like you all are fighting - with this
movement behind me - to expand voting rights, push for ambitious climate
change policy, put a cap on corporate monopolies, and finally to pass
Medicare for All,” [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9761?t=1019&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]she told us Tuesday.

Rep. Lee was an original cosponsor of Medicare for All and the first to
introduce a single payer healthcare bill in California. She was also one
of the first climate champions — working to end taxpayer-funded giveaways
to Big Oil and pledging to not take money from the fossil fuels industry.
In fact, she’s not taking any corporate PAC money!

Barbara has worked closely with Bernie Sanders for many years — and he
needs her as a partner in the Senate. Together, they co-founded the
Congressional Progressive Caucus and, just recently, introduced a bill to
tax the wealthy.

She was among the first to the Fight for $15 and a Union, joining Bernie
and Keith Ellison on the picket lines with workers when no one else would
stand with them — and she is still fighting alongside labor in California.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/barbaralee_orgteam_2309/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1020&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]SIGN UP TO ORGANIZE WITH BARBARA LEE

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1021&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

“Barbara Lee is the perfect candidate. It’s not just about a voting record
and checking the boxes for Medicare for All and a Green New Deal. It’s
about understanding movement politics, the sacrifices and the struggles,”
said Ro Khanna. “Barbara Lee has that link to history — from Nelson
Mandela to Shirley Chisolm — and she’s not afraid to take a stand when
it’s not popular.”

Ro said Barbara can win this thing, but she will need the grassroots army
that Bernie had in California and beyond.

“I know if we organize, if we get out the vote on social media, on calls,
knocking doors. If we do all of the things Our Revolution is going to do,
Barbara can win,” Ro Khanna said. “We’re going to make history, we’re
going to put a true icon in the US Senate, I’m honored to co-chair her
campaign, as honored as I was to co-chair Bernie Sanders’ campaign.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9760?t=1022&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]WATCH OUR FULL TOWN HALL WITH BARBARA LEE HERE

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1023&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

Barbara Lee has been a leader in setting the agenda for our movement, she
has been marching with us in the streets and she’s been mentoring movement
leaders in Congress.

“I find myself almost daily asking 'what would Barbara Lee do?' and I plan
to move with the same foresight, accountability, and commitment to
community that has guided not only her time in public office but truly her
life’s work,” said Rep. Ayanna Pressley. “She will be California’s
senator, but she’ll be all of our senator. She will be the people’s
senator!”

Rep. Cori Bush told us that when she first entered Congress, Barbara Lee
was right there to welcome and guide her — even speaking on her behalf
when others tried to keep her off of the Judiciary Committee. “Barbara Lee
truly speaks for me,” Cori said.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1024&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

Rep. Mark Pocan spoke of Barbara’s long history of supporting LGBTQ rights
and fighting to deliver legislation for HIV/AIDS in California.

“The Senate needs Barbara Lee,” said Pocan. “If you want to transform the
Senate, make it more progressive, and give Bernie a real partner in the
Senate, we need to elect Barbara Lee.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1025&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

“This is the thing about Barbara Lee: integrity, honesty, sincerity and
unshakeable faith in standing up for what’s right and never backing down,”
Minnesota AG Keith Ellison testified at the town hall. “Barbara Lee is,
hands down, the best choice. No doubt.”

Progressive movement leaders are in Barbara Lee’s corner and the
grassroots are, too. In order to win this and defeat the big money trying
to buy this seat, we’ve got to organize.

That’s why Our Revolution is “swinging its network of grassroots activists
and a list of more than 1.1 million California supporters behind the
campaign that the Congresswoman identifies as ‘a march for justice for
all,’” [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9762?t=1026&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]The Nation reports.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/barbaralee_orgteam_2309/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1027&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

We invite you to join our fast-growing organizing team - Progressives for
Barbara Lee. Hundreds have already signed up, and there are lots of
different ways you can get involved and help.

You can be part of this team from anywhere in the country — making calls,
sharing out on social media, and more. If you're in California, you can
help by knocking doors or reaching out to friends - even hosting or
attending a house party!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/barbaralee_orgteam_2309/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1028&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]Join Our Revolution’s Progressives for Barbara Lee organizing team.
Let's make this a people-powered campaign and send Barbara Lee to the
Senate.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1029&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

Our Revolution worked hard to get out the vote for Wendell Gilliard for
State Senate in South Carolina, but the establishment and big developers
helped his opponent win the runoff by just 11 votes.

This election is likely to go to a recount, but this shows the importance
of investing in organizing and making sure we reach every voter to get out
to the polls on election day.

State Rep. Gilliard was a 2020 campaign co-chair for Bernie, and like
Bernie, he has been a powerful champion of working people for decades. We
will continue partnering with him in the fights to come!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9759?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1030&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]Donate now to our 2024 Progressive Power Fund to make sure we have the
resources to defeat Trump and the GOP, flip the House and elect
progressives like Barbara Lee to the Senate!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1031&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

Our Revolution members weighed in and we are endorsing an exciting slate
of progressive champions in Duluth, MN!

We’re organizing to elect these three amazing women: Miranda Pacheco and
Jenna Yeakle for City Council At-Large and Wendy Durrwachter for City
Council District 1.

These candidates have a real shot at winning and building a strong
progressive bloc of local power in Minnesota, and we can’t let an
opportunity like this pass us by!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1032&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

Our Revolution is endorsing progressive grassroots organizer Leah Perkel
for City Council in Vancouver, WA (Position 6)!

Leah is an Our Revolution member and a former Bernie delegate. She has
firsthand experience with medical debt resulting from our lousy private
health insurance system, and she wants to be an agent of change to help
create healthier people and communities.

Leah will stand up to the big money interests and be a voice for the
people on affordable housing, the environment, equity, and more. She has
also been endorsed by OneAmerica, founded by US Rep. Pramila Jayapal.

★ ★ ★

VICTORY! Mayor Brandon Johnson on Monday delivered on his campaign promise
to eliminate the “subminimum wage” for tipped workers!

The new law calls for tipped workers — currently paid 60% of Chicago’s
minimum wage — to receive 8% annual increases beginning next July until
they reach 100% parity in 2028, the [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9767?t=1035&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]Chicago Sun-Times reports.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8480?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1036&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ][IMG]

In July, Mayor Brandon Johnson joined us to serve up food to restaurant
workers and raise awareness in this fight. Our own members submitted
testimony directly, and we just won!

Our Revolution organizers also testified at a hearing in Montgomery
County, MD this week to build pressure for the tipped wage bill voters
overwhelmingly supported to be implemented without letting restaurants
shift the burden to diners under the guise of “service charges.”

And, stay tuned! In Ohio and Arizona, Our Revolution has teams canvassing
for signatures for petition drives that will put a $20+ MINIMUM WAGE
directly on the ballot in 2024.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9721?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_OR_20230925_NL_RevReportRS_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Newsletter&t=1037&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]Our movement is critical to advancing policies to address the many
crises facing our country. If you’re not already a monthly member of Our
Revolution, sign up today!

return on investment we need to see is for working class Americans,’” Our
Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese told [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9768?t=1039&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]The Hill this
week.

“Failure to do so risks losing working class voters. They either sit it
out or they vote for a Donald Trump-like figure who won his election by
promising to champion the deindustrialized Midwest,” Joseph said.

Joseph represented Our Revolution to speak at the [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9769?t=1040&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]LIVE Solidarity
Summer Rally with UAW last week with United Auto Workers President Sean
Fain, Working Families Party, and a powerful coalition of progressive
organizations supporting the striking workers.

this week, calling for a fair contract with pay, benefits, and working
conditions that reflect their worth and their humanity. We are proud to
stand in solidarity with workers today and every day.

White House.

Thanks to pressure from organizers and a growing coalition of medical debt
activists around the country, the Biden administration is taking the first
steps toward removing medical bills from people’s credit scores, which
could improve ratings for millions.

deciding on loans and stop debt collectors from using credit ratings to
pressure people with health care-related debt, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/9770?t=1043&akid=4700%2E5885482%2EvqgGtt ]The Associated Press

clean_body: | | | | Peter, Last election our district was one of the races that helped us win the republican majority. Democrats are fighting tooth and nail to take OUR seat and OUR majority. That's why my End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline is so important – we have to hit every goal to win this race. But right now, we're still short of our $43,450 End-of-Quarter goal with just a few days to go. I'm counting on your help, Peter. | My finance team created this personal link so I can see your donation: Thanks for being a huge part of my team! Lori | | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. Friend,
Big Tech has been writing its own rules for too long.
Without proper guardrails, these companies have invaded our privacy, harmed our kids, and damaged the foundation of our democracy. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, it’s more urgent than ever that our leaders in Washington take action.
Michael has led the charge on regulating digital platforms and holding Big Tech accountable.
He’s introduced a number of bills to the Senate as part of this fight. These laws would make Congress better equipped to oversee Big Tech, protect consumers and the public interest, and ensure that emerging technologies don’t violate our fundamental rights.
Small businesses in Colorado shouldn’t face more regulations than the most powerful companies in the world. Big Tech no longer gets to go unchecked while hurting our kids and unraveling the social fabric of our country.
It’s time for the United States to set the standard.
We created a petition calling on Congress to regulate Big Tech companies. Together, we can protect our kids, privacy, and democracy. Will you sign on now? [https://secure.michaelbennet.com/a/x_092523_bigtech]

clean_body: We are on your team. Will you be on ours? | | | Peter, By now, we are sure you have seen the video , but you probably don’t know much about how our new, color-changing mug landed in President Biden’s hand. We knew we wanted to make color-changing mugs happen, but we could never have anticipated how many people it would take to make it real. In June, our team of unionized designers started mocking up the base graphic. And while that was happening, our product masterminds started running science experiments to figure out the magic sunglasses. Eventually, we figured it all out and made our first prototype that worked. The only problem was, we needed a LOT more of them --thousands more. Making the number we needed required a print shop in Texas to find this machine and a father and son to drive it to them all the way from Connecticut. When it arrived, we had to hope it worked right: We couldn’t tell for certain just yet because the warehouse was so hot, the ink was invisible. Now, each time we have a cup of joe with our , we are reminded of the talent and grit it took to make it real. We united folks from D.C. to Delaware to Texas to Connecticut to make a mug that could be sent to you anywhere in America (and help reelect Joe and Kamala!), Peter. That’s something special! We hope each time you use it, you remember everyone who is in this fight alongside you! Thank you for your support, Biden-Harris Merch Team

body:
assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back.

I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas.

_**But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.**_

[**Will you help my son?**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d5d7ceae5b6472cbf16fad56339bf4a&_e=LcF8ugq9aQLc6rxn3kpe6PveeK5Cv5rw5nGBD_cALBglhA9SEZ8MCSMh7bmmzFm-YHegTJ7J4QI8OTV8m08BrM5yqp8TCJ6PSwfAmK6-0Nsw7Xd4LKvZAUhFNfEYKFuuAJzM0nheURfIEg2dyNoXJ31CulLOrer9fxwoslNR05YB9CnTXx2iC08kOeKA54SKecrBJnJh4MqElUC912qbErSYUar48zMkpdRRrIyO9ENX3L3QMixkI9Xi4ScsgOzUzISSX4NsHMmUrO9XgQ8jql9ozqZI5JAAiX83GWGZAOtx55mzLOx2Lj121DYXlLxe2G7sDz_LwLUBXPYBTEbzJ24zCAHoo1vyPQ-0b9YuM1kLRTr3j0BT91c08-ACFWcM)

That's Michael in the photo.

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d5d7ceae5b6472cbf16fad56339bf4a&_e=LcF8ugq9aQLc6rxn3kpe6PveeK5Cv5rw5nGBD_cALBglhA9SEZ8MCSMh7bmmzFm-YHegTJ7J4QI8OTV8m08BrM5yqp8TCJ6PSwfAmK6-0Nsw7Xd4LKvZAUhFNfEYKFuuAJzM0nheURfIEg2dyNoXJ31CulLOrer9fxwoslNR05YB9CnTXx2iC08kOeKA54SKecrBJnJh4MqElUC912qbEtpZ5E_gj_ZO1UAnzKAccWrr5no06dBxYZkqpMSnK3S_nqo1bQh2RG0qt2GLVxRsZ8LQh6JmXQsS7PlgPP0AHCZpDq2YHFC0Jflqmk-2k_inYf0Prb0YAeoHQ1nlWpQY4zdvPcLgRM7QXqQpp--gHPUR6mSLOcNxgQpeAFiU6Oxe) [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d5d7ceae5b6472cbf16fad56339bf4a&_e=LcF8ugq9aQLc6rxn3kpe6PveeK5Cv5rw5nGBD_cALBglhA9SEZ8MCSMh7bmmzFm-YHegTJ7J4QI8OTV8m08BrM5yqp8TCJ6PSwfAmK6-0Nsw7Xd4LKvZAUhFNfEYKFuuAJzM0nheURfIEg2dyNoXJ31CulLOrer9fxwoslNR05YB9CnTXx2iC08kOeKA54SKecrBJnJh4MqElUC912qbEkzpr7XDUGpxgTTTFxL77XGTssgwQZlA_I4gXo_S4_ZbePjVPcbHdP5AKVKoYgV1CKoUg7BexFe8zif315EoFnqS2tQVtcHEPyO4slZp9cWWrTFJGGQIFuBR4q0zQymWsJjBDl5z8Xcrwv4tP4RWNRy-g1bATSJwbMvG1r1yBQAW)

In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve.

I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job.

Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty.

It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years.

What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need.

I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist.

Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats.

Fear of losing their jobs.

I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back.

**But I was wrong.**

_So_ _now_ _Michael 's_ _life_ _is_ _at_ _stake_ _for_ _simply_ _doing_ _his_ _job_ _and_ _we_ _have_ _nobody_ _to_ _turn_ _to_ _except_ _for_ _good_ _hearted_ _strangers_ _like_ _you._

**[Will you please help me save my son Michael?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d5d7ceae5b6472cbf16fad56339bf4a&_e=LcF8ugq9aQLc6rxn3kpe6PveeK5Cv5rw5nGBD_cALBglhA9SEZ8MCSMh7bmmzFm-YHegTJ7J4QI8OTV8m08BrM5yqp8TCJ6PSwfAmK6-0Nsw7Xd4LKvZAUhFNfEYKFuuAJzM0nheURfIEg2dyNoXJ31CulLOrer9fxwoslNR05YB9CnTXx2iC08kOeKA54SKecrBJnJh4MqElUC912qbEv6skZNSQPh5uPjy0wpDOKat2cAWXBROaxy3xji-H6bjnup5JC0Nd1Xp-TlyPqYy5Dt6aEBkiYKP2FaGPZFo_pCa3lbFU7IBMIgl3AvuSfyPt6oM57C3_6DlYfTqjfSqzBubOWz4NlmvPLGNbnWlaT50FcQHXFuW-M9L5wepsI-c)**

Let me give you some more of the details...

Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade."

The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police.

Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man.

When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car.

The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him.

Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired.

The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene.

My son suffered back and leg injuries.

Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck.

In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community.

There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day.

He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others.

But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years.

Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did?

That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. **[Even if that means asking folks like you for financial support to help my son afford the best possible attorneys and legal advice.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d5d7ceae5b6472cbf16fad56339bf4a&_e=LcF8ugq9aQLc6rxn3kpe6PveeK5Cv5rw5nGBD_cALBglhA9SEZ8MCSMh7bmmzFm-YHegTJ7J4QI8OTV8m08BrM5yqp8TCJ6PSwfAmK6-0Nsw7Xd4LKvZAUhFNfEYKFuuAJzM0nheURfIEg2dyNoXJ31CulLOrer9fxwoslNR05YB9CnTXx2iC08kOeKA54SKecrBJnJh4MqElUC912qbEkNpQgK-4L6o8sMLctkhWPLJPnHdGJ1so__lc08EBtmloGAN0AIBTIdVns7NZRJXETkVDhq7hOER1U1vJxg6QuyuGbs--erMR05nx3SSQPJztpox9MXQKl1Zmx9oCoguFnFmjQUKNlgRzllMdBm9INHVlrikKiYDrIZWMS_x3O-T)**

After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died.

But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified.

And then our whole world was rocked.

**Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted.**

Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said:

"We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never."

I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court.

We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense.

After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser.

They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" - and helping him violated their terms of service.

So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds.

No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process.

Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime."

Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael.

_With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading._

Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). **LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have.**

LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.

The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.

And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son!

**[Will you please consider sending a tax-deductible contribution to the LELDF so they can help my son beat his charges?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d5d7ceae5b6472cbf16fad56339bf4a&_e=LcF8ugq9aQLc6rxn3kpe6PveeK5Cv5rw5nGBD_cALBglhA9SEZ8MCSMh7bmmzFm-YHegTJ7J4QI8OTV8m08BrM5yqp8TCJ6PSwfAmK6-0Nsw7Xd4LKvZAUhFNfEYKFuuAJzM0nheURfIEg2dyNoXJ31CulLOrer9fxwoslNR05YB9CnTXx2iC08kOeKA54SKecrBJnJh4MqElUC912qbEpNDBrdrzArpJOS-srEJLGPRaEFjcUXoNLw9OcApnZMhAATtWrkpAOJ8wHiXX_j4elJwh5UdVGrCGxWgZrienTntYfBYu9ZCADeSHtIbOxHsl5ZVX3xvH9aj6gXdHWSqJuXC4JEtMatGJIb08NXtFHQdG0kcC8Q0hiaAJfZ3R9HZ)**

You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers.

Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a **[gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more,](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d5d7ceae5b6472cbf16fad56339bf4a&_e=LcF8ugq9aQLc6rxn3kpe6PveeK5Cv5rw5nGBD_cALBglhA9SEZ8MCSMh7bmmzFm-YHegTJ7J4QI8OTV8m08BrM5yqp8TCJ6PSwfAmK6-0Nsw7Xd4LKvZAUhFNfEYKFuuAJzM0nheURfIEg2dyNoXJ31CulLOrer9fxwoslNR05YB9CnTXx2iC08kOeKA54SKecrBJnJh4MqElUC912qbEi1p6jtiDVdFS4rrkrDAwhQkSHUoyoNdNO-Ny7aXQuFc8QRm00ddfBP9PJPUwUnBvcwxMi8wbFkR3cayU-IHaI8d3fAoeyX-1X8nXBT7fBdxz48P5RInLGGQLXLq0PRdd30rTmXqmp_vlHqYjJjb8DSj_atO1pcqjYoQhWLgM6N5)** I pray you will consider doing so.

Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing.

If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers.

My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal.
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d5d7ceae5b6472cbf16fad56339bf4a&_e=LcF8ugq9aQLc6rxn3kpe6PveeK5Cv5rw5nGBD_cALBglhA9SEZ8MCSMh7bmmzFm-YHegTJ7J4QI8OTV8m08BrM5yqp8TCJ6PSwfAmK6-0Nsw7Xd4LKvZAUhFNfEYKFuuAJzM0nheURfIEg2dyNoXJ31CulLOrer9fxwoslNR05YB9CnTXx2iC08kOeKA54SKecrBJnJh4MqElUC912qbEmJSYEIpHS6sn_zaRq4z-gGfyJDFLu-5YwIZG1Hfwtv3vZ6b1dIOUqLlKXO4PO6qiK_8WTXNdhzJVroMIsWqxknLIb52Fles_1BpwNuh0rVcQ11D214MRTZJ1ZL_cZ-le9r52tyaiCJgd-OUV4cs9GgDEkpqMpaIJvPKFNkU_wTS)
_That's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn_
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d5d7ceae5b6472cbf16fad56339bf4a&_e=LcF8ugq9aQLc6rxn3kpe6PveeK5Cv5rw5nGBD_cALBglhA9SEZ8MCSMh7bmmzFm-YHegTJ7J4QI8OTV8m08BrM5yqp8TCJ6PSwfAmK6-0Nsw7Xd4LKvZAUhFNfEYKFuuAJzM0nheURfIEg2dyNoXJ31CulLOrer9fxwoslNR05YB9CnTXx2iC08kOeKA54SKecrBJnJh4MqElUC912qbEq3Iz8DtoazDK2o2KytWN0bKKrA8w3hqmbb2_j7fnqSN3idtOqoAQh8A6BhQ_zya1xFma8nm76ZIzCdFrQAgcNNAeAjotVEXr2-WSti4J3eqXoswJ7ech3atw-ghLKYKx2T4G0wIGbo1TLi-WcGy0jw0nFc5k9ZN2KTnbOyzWUqi)
_That's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William_

I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today.

Sincerely,

Margaret Mary Dunn

I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael. Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas. But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck. That's Michael in the photo. In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve. I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job. Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty. It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years. What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need. I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist. Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats. Fear of losing their jobs. I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back. But I was wrong. So now Michael 's life is at stake for simply doing his job and we have nobody to turn to except for good hearted strangers like you. Let me give you some more of the details... Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade." The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police. Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man. When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car. The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him. Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired. The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene. My son suffered back and leg injuries. Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck. In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community. There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day. He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others. But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years. Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did? That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died. But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified. And then our whole world was rocked. Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted. Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said: "We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never." I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court. We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense. After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser. They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" - and helping him violated their terms of service. So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds. No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process. Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime." Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael. With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading. Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have. LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty. The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department. And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son! You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers. Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a I pray you will consider doing so. Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers. My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal. That's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn That's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today. ---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Sea turtles and other precious marine life are DYING from rampant plastic pollution! ** Our oceans are being completely overrun by plastic waste -- **85% of the debris in the ocean is plastic** , and it's _**KILLING OVER A MILLION marine animals**_ like turtles, dolphins, and sea birds each year. Helpless animals DIE when they _**choke or become entangled**_ in plastic debris, and scientists agree that baby sea turtles are ingesting plastic at an alarming rate, finding them with _**dangerous levels of these toxic plastics**_ in their tiny stomachs. Experts even predict there will be **more plastic than fish in the ocean** by 2050 in what they are calling the __**PLASTIC APOCALYPSE**__ \-- **with plastic eventually TAKING OVER THE EARTH.** [_**We’re running out of time, Friend. Will you help protect our oceans and our planet from being decimated by plastics? Take action now before it’s too late >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2010492?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2010493?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Plastic never goes away, but instead breaks into smaller pieces becoming microplastics that CONTAMINATE our water and food supply -- _**even ending up in the air we breathe.**_
All of the plastic made is just building up on earth, consuming our beaches, our oceans, and our planet – **while greedy corporate plastic manufacturers continue to steadily increase production in order to turn a profit.**
**What’s worse is that even the production itself is hurting the environment.** Plastic manufacturing **_burns through massive amounts of fossil fuels, releases harmful emissions, and _leaves nearby residents susceptible to health risks,__** most often low-wealth and communities of color.
[_**Plastic pollution is out of control and it’s threatening to DESTROY our entire planet. We must demand IMMEDIATE action to STOP the plastic crisis -- or there will be DEVASTATING consequences. Add your name to join the fight NOW >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2010494?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Fellow Conservative,

In 2019, when I decided to run for the State Senate, I was driven by one simple reason: I had to advocate for the people who were facing life’s biggest challenges and those who love them. **People like my husband Andy.** When Andy was battling cancer, paid leave allowed him to focus on the full-time job of getting care. And my employer’s flexibility allowed me to be there by his side to care for him. We were both lucky. But, through our struggle, and sharing with others, I came across so many other families who simply didn’t have that same benefit. Patients forced to choose between their job and their health care. Parents going back to work days after giving birth. Family members who had to choose between their paycheck and their loved one’s needs. **Making paid leave possible for workers and families across Delaware was a huge part of why I ran for the State Senate.** Andy’s and my struggle shaped the very bill I introduced (and passed!) in the Senate. The Healthy Delaware Families Act provided workers with up to 12 weeks of paid leave — **the largest expansion of the social safety net in modern state history.** **Now, I’m asking for your help so we can work for those too often left out in Congress.** Paid leave, early childhood education, gun safety, health care that meets our needs, protections for members of the LGBTQ+ community, reforming our criminal justice system, and much, much more. **That’s what you can count on me to work for in Washington.** [So, if you’re able, please consider making a contribution to our campaign right now. clean_body: In 2019, when I decided to run for the State Senate, I was driven by one simple reason: | = In 2019, when I decided to run for the State Senate, I was driven by one simple reason: I had to advocate for the people who were facing life’s biggest challenges and those who love them. People like my husband Andy. When Andy was battling cancer, paid leave allowed him to focus on the full-time job of getting care. And my employer’s flexibility allowed me to be there by his side to care for him. We were both lucky. But, through our struggle, and sharing with others, I came across so many other families who simply didn’t have that same benefit. Patients forced to choose between their job and their health care. Parents going back to work days after giving birth. Family members who had to choose between their paycheck and their loved one’s needs. Making paid leave possible for workers and families across Delaware was a huge part of why I ran for the State Senate. Andy’s and my struggle shaped the very bill I introduced (and passed!) in the Senate. The Healthy Delaware Families Act provided workers with up to 12 weeks of paid leave — the largest expansion of the social safety net in modern state history. Now, I’m asking for your help so we can work for those too often left out in Congress. Paid leave, early childhood education, gun safety, health care that meets our needs, protections for members of the LGBTQ+ community, reforming our criminal justice system, and much, much more. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:
No images? [Click here](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-e-ajiiitd-trhiujldw-n/) [](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajiiitd-trhiujldw-r/) Dear CaucusRoom Members:We need your help-- please give us your honest feedback about CaucusRoom as we consider how to sustain and grow this community. Read this update and **[take our survey](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajiiitd-trhiujldw-y/)** at the bottom of this newsletter. **CaucusRoom's Powerful Community****[CaucusRoom](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajiiitd-trhiujldw-j/)** is now in our fourth year of operations. We've got a great community, built powerful organizing tools, and accomplished incredibly important things together.
* We hosted three State GOP Conventions and over 150 smaller GOP assemblies virtually.
* We trained hundreds of conservatives to become election judges.
* We mobilized by the thousands for important causes, such as writing our Senators to get Amy Coney Barrett confirmed to the Supreme Court.
* And [**we've laughed**](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajiiitd-trhiujldw-t/), learned, and commiserated as we started each morning with our morning newsletter.

**The Challenge **Our most elusive goal is to identify a sustainable source of revenue to run our small company. We've created several business lines -- most importantly, our **[virtual meeting and webinar services for Groups](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajiiitd-trhiujldw-i/)**. The meetings are fantastic and competitively priced against Zoom. Start a Group and give them a try!We need at least 2,000 Groups to subscribe to [**CaucusRoom Live**](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajiiitd-trhiujldw-u/) to make it sustainable. We recently pursued two promising paths that would have delivered many clients in one contract. Sadly, they didn't work out. We have now scaled down to a bare-bones operation to preserve cash and to rethink our business model. **The Newsletter:** We really want to bring the newsletter back and much more- but we need your help. Please take the short 45-second survey below.Thank you from the CaucusRoom Team! [Would you pay $2 per month for the newsletter?](https://caucusroom.cmail19.com/t/i-l-ajiiitd-trhiujldw-o/)

Hot Labor Summer has become Hot Labor Fall,** ** Peter.

https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/581050/ [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/581050/]
Thursday 9/28:
Join Freedom Virginia and leaders from Generation Ratify Virginia, Voters of Tomorrow, the Coalition for Virginia's Future, and other youth organizations; to hear the unique perspectives that young voters bring to the table around issues of economic affordability.
Click here to sign up via Mobilize
Sign up here [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/581050/]
https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/580412/ [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/580412/] Saturday 9/30:
Join Freedom Virginia & friends to canvass for Atoosa Reaser (candidate for House District 27) and Suhas Subramanyam (candidate for Senate District 32). Meet us at 11am to knock doors and introduce our community to the fantastic affordability advocates we have in these two!
Click here to sign up via Mobilize
Sign up here [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/580412/]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMMP/1/85567/images/JOIN%20%281%29.png] Sunday 10/1:
Don’t miss our joint canvass with special guest Sen. Mark Warner, Planned Parenthood Advocates of Virginia, Freedom Virginia, REPRO Rising, Generation Ratify, Emily’s list and others! Join us as we knock doors for reproductive rights champion Russet Perry.
Check the Planned Parenthood Advocates of Virginia website for updates on this event

Join Freedom Virginia and Loudoun's Democratic candidates for state office at the Hal + Burni Hanson Park's Picnic Pavilion #5 for mingling and an informal candidate panel! We'll have pumpkin painting and the playground for kids, apple cider and fall snacks for all, and the chance to meet your local Democratic candidates for state office!
Click here to sign up via Mobilize
Sign up here [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/572215/]
https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/580294/ [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/580294/] Thursday 10/5:
Education is a key issue in this fall's election in Virginia. Come out and support Monty Mason for Senate and learn about his views on Education and continuing progressive movement forward in Education in Virginia. Light refreshments provided. Please invite others.
Click here to sign up via Mobilize
Sign up here [https://www.mobilize.us/freedomva/event/580294/]
