Friend, For 17 years, the official U.S. Military policy towards LGBTQ+ servicemembers was one of pure discrimination. Don't Ask, Don't Tell prevented countless qualified Americans from serving in our armed forces. It betrayed our values and made our country less safe. I was serving on the Board of the Human Rights Campaign when President Obama relegated DADT to the dustbin of history just over 12 years ago. It was a victory for civil rights that we had fought hard for — but it wasn't the end of the road. Federal law still doesn't include explicit anti-discrimination protections for LGBTQ+ Americans. The Supreme Court is rolling back civil rights, and red states across the country have passed dozens of hateful laws targeting trans-Americans. [**Friend, Sepi has experienced this discrimination firsthand, and she's dedicated her life to fighting back. We need a civil rights champion like her in Eric Early is a husband, father, attorney, businessman and son of a Marine. **Not a career politician.** Eric was raised to believe in America’s founding principles of limited government and free markets. As the co-owner and Managing Partner of a nationally recognized law firm, Eric understands how difficult it is to start and run a successful business. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: A handful of extremists want to shut down the government to help out Donald Trump’s chances, and we need to call it out.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Republicans tout how they fight for the everyman. But that isn’t really true — at all.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=78%2E4032634%2E9V3uKa)
---
You know, I’d like to think that politicians run for office to lead the government and help people. But the GOP doesn’t seem to be interested in that. They tout how they fight for the everyman. But that isn’t really true — at all.

As we continue to plummet towards the October 1 deadline to pass a spending bill, Kevin McCarthy and his House Republicans called it a week last week and went home rather than debating this bill and working to avoid a government shutdown.

A handful of extremists are not budging on their demands for spending cuts and unrealistic conservative policies — because they believe that if they can cause a shutdown and impose more pain on the American people and more chaos in Washington, it will increase Donald Trump's chances of winning re-election. And Kevin McCarthy’s failure to lead is enabling this.

It's really dangerous — and we need to call it out.

In the short-term, I’m going to do everything in my power to urge the House to get serious, do their jobs, and avoid a shutdown. And at the same time, I’m pushing for the critical funding that working families need in this spending bill — like for childcare.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=30457%2E3422442%2Efjl4SZ)
Derek, I was one of the first Democrats to call on Senator Bob Menendez to resign last week because every American deserves to feel confident their elected officials are fighting for them, **not literally lining their pockets with cash.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230925-2?amount=&refcode=EMAL25_2_BOB_20230925_V1_F&refcode2=30457_3422442_fjl4SZ&akid=30457%2E3422442%2Efjl4SZ)
I’m not afraid to call out corruption when I see it, even when it (sadly) comes from fellow Democrats. I first ran for Congress in 2018 because I saw how urgently we needed to root out corruption in Washington, and [**joined MSNBC last week to talk more about this, you can click here to watch.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230925-2?amount=&refcode=EMAL25_2_BOB_20230925_V1_F&refcode2=30457_3422442_fjl4SZ&akid=30457%2E3422442%2Efjl4SZ)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230925-2?amount=&refcode=EMAL25_2_BOB_20230925_V1_F&refcode2=30457_3422442_fjl4SZ&akid=30457%2E3422442%2Efjl4SZ)
Derek, corruption in Washington doesn’t start and end with this one Senator. **And since coming to Congress in 2019, one of my main goals has been to clean. this. place. up.** I’ve led the fight to ban Members of Congress from trading stocks, I’m the only House Democrat to oppose earmarks— which are a way of funding politicians’ pet projects—and have been proud to be one of the few to reject corporate PAC, federal lobbyist, and Big Oil, Big Pharma, and Big Bank executive money.
**I’m able to stand tall against corruption because of the millions of grassroots supporters like you who have made it possible for me to even run a congressional campaign.** Now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate to keep up our fight. **[With our federal fundraising deadline less than a week away, today would be an excellent day to join our team. Can you chip in today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230925-2?amount=5&refcode=EMAL25_2_BOB_20230925_V1_F&refcode2=30457_3422442_fjl4SZ&akid=30457%2E3422442%2Efjl4SZ)**

Thanks for reading,
Katie

name: Josh Harder
subject: I’m worried, Peter
body:
Our deadline is almost here.
Hi all,
You know I’m not the one to send fake “sky is falling” emails - my campaign is always honest and transparent about our fundraising. So I’m going to tell it to you straight: we’re on track to be outraised by my GOP opponent.
**Kevin McCarthy has gone all in on his “dream candidate” to run against me and has raised tens of thousands of dollars for my opponent. Fancy champagne fundraisers, mass texts pleading for donations, anything my opponent asks for, McCarthy delivers.**
I want to explain why we’re falling behind and why this EOQ deadline is so important for our strategy. If you can please rush in a donation right now, I’ll leave a link _**[here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70361695/429083529/206852550?&refcode=E4268-20230925-Worried-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTVjNDRjYzgtZmE1Yi1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YkfbHQuCdgI2ETD_mcUxm-Zd6OiV1H9wRoudCtCbBcU=)**_.
**Where we stand:** Right now, we’re up against the wire to raise as much as we possibly can before the EOQ deadline on Saturday. This is our first major test against Kevin McCarthy and my new GOP opponent because after this deadline, we’ll have to submit our fundraising report. Everyone is going to be watching to see if my opponent outraises us.
**Why this matters:** Money talks. If my opponent gains the fundraising momentum even more money will flow into his campaign from national Republicans. That means more attack ads on me, both from my opponent and SuperPACs. If we don’t win this seat, there is no way Democrats can take back the House. Kevin McCarthy even admitted his GOP House majority hinges on this “competitive, must-win race!”
**What decisions we need to make:** After this deadline, we have a major decision to make. How much can we spend to respond to the negative attacks already coming at us? We want to launch new ads on social media, expand our field program, and invest in inexpensive (but effective) radio advertising to fight back against the lies. But I can’t agree to any of this if we’re behind our opponent in fundraising.
**Other considerations:** Let’s not forget we actually have an election in March! Because of California’s “top 2” primary, I’ll be on the ballot against my new GOP opponent 8 months before the general election. We need to have a strong turnout to show Democrats have the momentum in this race, and this deadline will be our last chance to compare our fundraising before we have to make critical decisions about the investments we can (or cannot make) towards getting out the vote.
**What I need from this team:** Well, let’s just say I really need your help hitting our fundraising goal! If we fall short, I could be outraised for the first time ever and the GOP will have a huge advantage ahead of our March election because we won’t have the resources to get our field organizing started or fight back against the negative ads against me. Remember, I don’t take a single dime of corporate PAC money so I’m really counting on your support!
That’s why I’m asking you to please send in the biggest donation you possibly can right now. It’s the only thing that’s going to help us reach this goal. Here is the link again: _**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-Sept2023-FR-EOQ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70361697/429083531/206852550?&refcode=E4268-20230925-Worried-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTVjNDRjYzgtZmE1Yi1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YkfbHQuCdgI2ETD_mcUxm-Zd6OiV1H9wRoudCtCbBcU=)**_
If you made it to the bottom of this long email, I’m impressed, and thank you.
\- Josh

Josh Harder for Congress
PO Box 4220
Manteca, CA 95337
United States

I’ll explain more in a moment, but first: This email will be a little bit longer than usual.**[So if you don’t have time to read it (that’s okay!), can I count on you to chip in before our FEC end-of-quarter deadline on September 30th? This is our most important end-of-quarter deadline yet, so I’d be eternally grateful for your grassroots support.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70361992/429084495/-796242365?refcode=em_fr_2023.09.25_b1_as_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MjIxZjE1Ny1mYzViLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bHTlSoCTaPf2ReTjN4NCX5hvnxeXrXkOs9MjafW0UwY=) **
| _[Chip in](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70361993/429084496/-796242365?refcode=em_fr_2023.09.25_b1_as_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MjIxZjE1Ny1mYzViLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bHTlSoCTaPf2ReTjN4NCX5hvnxeXrXkOs9MjafW0UwY=)_
---

_Allow me to explain..._

**After the month ends on September 30th, our campaign will be legally required to submit our internal fundraising numbers to the FEC.** As you may remember from previous end-of-quarter deadlines, these numbers will be made _publicly available_ for anyone and everyone to see.

That means everyone from political reporters to Republican strategists can scour our fundraising report to look for signs of weakness. **Safe to say, publishing a strong fundraising report could not be more important.**
_[Help us post a strong fundraising report>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70361994/429084497/-796242365?refcode=em_fr_2023.09.25_b1_as_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MjIxZjE1Ny1mYzViLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bHTlSoCTaPf2ReTjN4NCX5hvnxeXrXkOs9MjafW0UwY=)_
---

I know I’ve said this before, but asking people to chip in to my campaign is my least favorite part of the job. I ran for Congress to push for progress and fight for you – so you can trust that I wouldn’t ask for your money if I didn’t have to.

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

| | Reagan Dunn, J.D.
Vice Chairman King County Council
Friends,

In this hotly contested Presidential race, several candidates have already asserted themselves as worthy contenders for the title of President. However of those distinguished candidates, Governor DeSantis remains the best possible shot at bringing common sense politics back to the White House.

Supporting the Governor in his bid is the best thing we can do to ensure that our country is on the right track driven by results, and not by empty rhetoric. Our nation needs sound and competent leadership now more than ever, and Governor DeSantis is the only candidate who is up for the task.

**Come take this opportunity to support him on his path to the Presidency by joining an[event](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=4c0801ac85&e=77eef70c61) with his campaign staff this Thursday! **This is an excellent opportunity to meet the Governor's staff, to ask questions, and to meet others who are looking to support the Governor.

**I hope to see you there. All the info about how to attend the event can be found[here](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=539b784e8a&e=77eef70c61).**

Thank you so much for your time and support!

Sincerely,

****
Councilmember Reagan Dunn
